This is how endless wars begin.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260301-5961-footer&t=1&akid=5961%2E420207%2Ek_AOf3)
Peter,
This weekend, Donald Trump bombed Iran without congressional authorization — dragging the United States closer to another war in the Middle East.
Let me be clear: This is an unconstitutional war. Congress must vote immediately on a War Powers Resolution to force the president to stop — and I will be a strong yes vote.
The Constitution is explicit: the power to declare war belongs to Congress because putting American lives at risk is the most serious decision a nation can make. It requires debate, accountability, and the consent of the people.
**Trump has completely turned that on its head.**
He promised to end wars — and instead is starting new, unconstitutional wars. He is wasting American taxpayer dollars, putting our servicemembers in harm’s way, and showing blatant disrespect for the Constitution and the rule of law.
We cannot allow one man to unilaterally drag this country into war.
If you agree that Congress must reclaim its constitutional authority and stop this escalation, I’m asking you to stand with me today.
I don’t take corporate PAC money, and I don’t answer to defense contractors or the CEOs who make billions when bombs drop. I answer to you — the people — who have the most to lose if we start yet another endless war.
[**That’s why I’m asking you to chip in $3 or whatever you can right now to help me keep up the fight to stop forever wars and rein in Trump’s abuse of power.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260301.Bykunw&refcode=em20260301-5961&amount=3&t=2&akid=5961%2E420207%2Ek_AOf3)

The American people have said over and over again that we do not want another war. If we’re going to stop this one, we must stand together.
In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal

body:
From Colorado’s ballot push to the Iran strike — clarity over chaos.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**March 1, 2026** **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST**
| | Dear Rocky Mountain Voice family,
**👍 The Good News: Half a Million Voices for Colorado Kids** This week, our most-read story wasn’t about scandal or outrage — it was about momentum. [More than 500,000 signatures were submitted by Protect Kids Colorado to place three child-focused measures before voters.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Supporters turned in over 170,000 signatures for the Protect Women and Girls Sports Act, which would designate athletic teams by biological sex and preserve female-only categories. They also submitted more than 164,000 signatures for a measure prohibiting gender transition surgeries on minors and restricting public funding for those procedures. A third proposal would impose life without parole for those convicted of buying or selling sexual activity with a minor.
Now the Secretary of State will verify the signatures, but the margin appears substantial. No matter where you stand, this is undeniable: half a million signatures signals that Colorado voters want a say.
**🏛️ Meanwhile at the Capitol...** The legislature is debating parallel issues _NEXT WEEK_.
[HB26-1083](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), the Protect Female Sports Act, would require schools to designate teams by biological sex and prohibit males from competing on girls’ teams.
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[HB26-1128](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) would extend the statute of limitations for individuals who later seek legal recourse after undergoing gender transition procedures as minors. Both bills are scheduled for committee hearings in early March, offering Coloradans another opportunity to testify and engage in the process.
_Both bills are scheduled for hearings on March 9. To sign up for remote testimony or submit written testimony, visit the[Colorado General Assembly website](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and follow the instructions for committee hearings (typically through their testimony signup portal or by contacting the committee staff)._
Whether through ballot initiatives or committee hearings, these conversations are no longer confined to activist circles — they’re happening statewide.__
**🌍 A Word on Iran** This weekend, the United States carried out coordinated strikes against Iran, targeting military assets and reportedly killing Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. U.S. Central Command confirmed strikes on ballistic missile facilities, and multiple Iranian naval assets were destroyed.
Polling released prior to the operation showed strong support among Americans — particularly Republican voters — for preventing Iran from obtaining a nuclear weapon. There is already no shortage of hot takes, outrage threads, and partisan spin flooding social media. Instead of adding to the noise, we’re directing to the most recent update from [Trump's press conference TODAY here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). If you want the facts without the frenzy, start there. We'll provide more commentary throughout the upcoming week.
In truth & liberty, Team RMV
---
| | |
---
| | **TOP STORIES OF THE WEEK**
---
**[Half a million signatures filed for youth medical, girls’ sports and child trafficking measures](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) More than half a million signatures were gathered and delivered with a single stated aim, placing before Colorado voters a set of measures supporters say are designed to protect children.

**[After Trump pulls endorsement, CD3 Republicans weigh loyalty and constitutional independence](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) President Donald Trump’s decision to revoke his endorsement of Rep. Jeff Hurd and instead back primary challenger Hope Scheppelman reshaped the Republican race in Colorado’s 3rd Congressional District. It also sharpened a debate inside the party: does representation mean standing firm on constitutional ground—even when that conflicts with the president—or aligning closely with the America First agenda?

**[Human Trafficking Concerns Resurface as Epstein Files Cite Colorado Links](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) With the U.S. Department of Justice’s release of 3 million more files pertaining to convicted sex felon Jeffrey Epstein, multiple written mentions of alleged connections to Colorado towns and business owners have come to light. A word search of the documents for “Colorado” generates 1,485 hits, with inquiries for cities including Denver and Aspen generating several thousands more.

|
---
**LEGISLATIVE SESSION**
_**Quick Summary of the Week:**_ _**In the Senate:** It was a full week in the upper chamber, with _[SB26-018](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_ , _[SB26-005](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_ , and _[SB26-065](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_ on the calendar, though the _[seed coating bill](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_ (SB26-065) was postponed indefinitely. Lawmakers took up _[SB26-043](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_ on Friday, the _[“barrel control bill,”](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_ as the debate over firearm regulations intensifies following a heated House fight over _[restrictions on 3D-printed firearms](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_._
_****_
_**In the House:** House Republicans touted several policy wins focused on jobs and families, including extending the Job Growth Incentive Tax Credit, strengthening mail ballot signature verification, expanding the Cottage Foods Act, and improving access to behavioral health care. They also helped defeat what they described as duplicative emissions reporting mandates that would have imposed steep penalties on businesses.

**Upcoming:** Caucus leaders signaled upcoming fights over new firearm dealer regulations, expanded red flag petitions, and permanent price-control proposals. As major bills move through committee next week, House Republicans are urging Coloradans to testify and stay engaged._ ____
|
---
**[State approval to farm? Lawmakers debate new limits on seed and pest control](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SEN. BYRON PELTON, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _Colorado’s farmers and ranchers already face significant challenges, including volatile commodity prices, rising input costs, labor shortages, and unpredictable weather. They should not also have to contend with a state legislature that increasingly seeks to regulate how they protect crops and livestock._
**[“Apologize to the Constitution”: House rejects amendment on 3D gun bill](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The debate over 3D-printed firearms took an unexpected turn Friday when Rep. Scott Bottoms stepped forward with a constitutional warning. House Bill 26-1144 would ban the 3D printing of firearms and certain gun parts. Bottoms said if it violates the Constitution, it should fall.

**[GriftoPolis’s Green Mandate Mirage: Sacrificing Jobs and Reliability for a Fraction of a Degree](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY REP. KEN DEGRAAF, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _Coloradans, let’s cut through the fog of feel-good policies and face the harsh reality of our state’s energy “transition.” We’re being sold a bill of goods on decarbonization, where the costs pile up on families and communities while the benefits are so minuscule they’re practically imaginary.
_
_**[READ MORE ON LEGISLATIVE SESSION](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
|
---
**STATE**
**[Dathan Jones announces U.S. Senate run, says he “Can no longer sit on the sidelines”](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) With housing prices climbing toward half a million dollars, grocery bills stretching household budgets, and energy policy battles intensifying across the state, Colorado’s affordability crisis is emerging as a defining issue of the 2026 U.S. Senate race.

**[From $8 Billion to $16 Billion: How Colorado’s Medicaid Budget Doubled in a Decade](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) If you ask most Colorado families how they feel about health care right now, the answers aren’t complicated. It’s expensive. It’s confusing. It keeps going up. And for taxpayers helping fund Colorado’s Medicaid program — known as Health First Colorado — another question has started to surface.
**[The question no court has answered: Was Tina Peters jailed for speech?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Despite months and months of litigation in both state and federal courts, no appellate court has ruled on whether Tina Peters’ speech was constitutionally protected—or whether it was improperly used to justify keeping her behind bars.

**[Running on the American Dream: Inside Joshi’s Senate Campaign](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Dr. Janak Joshi is back on the campaign trail — this time seeking the Republican nomination for U.S. Senate. The physician and former state legislator is entering Colorado’s caucus process, which begins March 3, ahead of district and state assemblies and the June primary.

_**[READ MORE STATE NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
|
---
**NATIONAL**
**[They Would Not Stand for Americans](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** C. J. GARBO, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _During the State of the Union, Donald Trump issued a clear and direct statement. “If you agree with this statement, then stand up and show your support: The first duty of the American government is to protect American citizens, not illegal immigrants.”_

**[CDC Document Reveals Proposed Nationwide Quarantine Camps During Covid](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)[BROWNSTONE INSTITUTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) No matter how bad you think Covid policies were, they were intended to be worse. Consider the vaccine passports alone. Six cities were locked down to include only the vaccinated in public indoor places. They were New York City, Boston, Chicago, New Orleans, Washington, D.C., and Seattle. __
**[Texas Democrat says President Trump’s State of the Union changed her vote](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[USA TODAY](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _I watched President Donald Trump‘s entire 2026 State of the Union speech. And I loved it! Watching it made me more likely to vote in the midterm elections. This was the first time I wasn’t bored and actually agreed with everything he had to say._
_**[READ MORE NATIONAL NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
|
---
**LOCAL**
**[Parents Accuse DPS of Sidestepping TABOR Limits and Violating Colorado Organized Crime Control Act](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The parent advocacy group that previously accused Denver Public Schools of financial misconduct in court documents has escalated its claims, alleging the district engaged in racketeering through its bond and lease-financing structures.
__
**[Denver Mayor Orders Police To Intervene In ICE Operations If Force Deemed Excessive](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Denver Mayor Mike Johnston on Thursday outlined his city’s response to immigration enforcement operations, including intervening to stop federal officers when local police observe them using “excessive” force.
__

**[Denver Leaders Face Tough Questions After Data Center Company CoreSite Skips Community Meeting](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[DENVER7](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) During a town hall on Tuesday night, residents of Denver’s Globeville and Elyria-Swansea neighborhoods demanded answers from city leaders, state officials, and business representatives about the impacts of a new data center being built in the area.

**_[READ MORE LOCAL NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_**
|
---
**COMMENTARY**
**[Colorado should drop its membership in the California Clean Car Cartel.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SEAN PAIGE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _President Trump’s recent repeal of the “endangerment finding”—a Barack Obama-era rule that handed the federal government absolute power to regulate almost anything that emits CO2 emissions, in response to the alleged climate crisis—marks a potential turning point for Colorado._
**[As in the Days of Noah: Moral Decline, Divine Patience, and the Certainty of Judgment](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY C. J. GARBO, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _Civilizations do not collapse at random. They follow patterns. Scripture presents that pattern with clarity. Moral order produces stability. Moral rebellion produces decay. The sequence is consistent across centuries and continents._
**[President Trump’s Historic Year of Achievements for Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY CHRISTY FIDURA, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _When Joe Biden left office, he left a legacy of weakness, wokeness, and worry among the American people about our nation’s future. In just over one year, President Trump has turned America around to ensure that the state of our Union is strong, and the future is bright._
**_[READ MORE COMMENTARY](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_**
|

body:
Never mind that Georgia conducted two full recounts of the 2020 election — one by machine and another by hand. Never mind the millions of taxpayers dollars spent by Georgia investigating the lies and conspiracy theories about fraud that found nothing. Forget the fact that Trump and his allies filed, and lost, eight cases aimed at throwing out the results.
This ballot seizure is a strategic effort to cast doubt on the veracity of the 2020 election and a dry run to do the same if MAGA-aligned candidates lose in 2026.
RUSH $35 or more right now to fuel our efforts to protect our fundamental right to vote and make every vote count in November nationwide >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=030126_2&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
AJC: FBI raids Fulton County, Georgia, election office [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=030126_2&amount=25]
Just weeks ago, Team, the FBI raided the Fulton County, Georgia, (home to Atlanta) Elections Operation Center. The Atlanta Journal-Constitution (AJC) reported that the activity was “ apparently connected to the Trump administration’s long-held and disproven belief that Fulton’s handling of the 2020 presidential election was rife with fraud .”
You read that right -- instead of focusing on the crucial issues facing our country, MAGA and Trump have weaponized the investigative power of the Justice Department and the FBI to try and justify their lies that the 2020 election was stolen from him .
The search warrant authorized agents to search for and seize all “physical ballots from the 2020 general election” as well as ballot images produced by scanning ballots, voter rolls from that year, and tabulator tapes. It’s highly unlikely the investigation will turn up any vote count fraud connected to the 2020 election results in Fulton County as those results, like elsewhere, have been recounted, audited, and litigated already, costing millions in taxpayer dollars and finding no misdeeds.
That's not stopping the opponents of voting rights in the Trump administration, however. This is their perfect opportunity for a test run of their suppressive power ahead of November's midterm elections.
We must do everything we can to protect our free and fair elections -- not just before them, but during and after. Help our fight to make every vote count with $35 or whatever you can today >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=030126_2&amount=35]

The scariest part? Tulsi Gabbard, the Director of National Intelligence (DNI), was also seen on site during the raid .
Needless to say, the DNI doesn't have any law enforcement role and has no power over domestic issues. Senator Mark Warner, ranking member on the Senate Intelligence Committee ( which is required by law to be informed of foreign intelligence issues ), said they haven't been informed of any reason for her involvement, despite Trump later going on Truth Social to claim that an out-of-power former President Obama took millions of dollars in cash payments in 2020 meant for Iran and diverted the money to Italy to pay for the CIA to hack voting machines in coordination with China.
Feeling lost? Us too. Rather than understand the simple truth that voters changed their mind about Trump after his first term and wanted to give someone else a try in charge, these conspiracy theorists would rather believe that a country that hates America (Iran) wouldn't complain about not getting paid. And that Iran would be OK with a former president taking millions of dollars to pay an American ally (Italy) and a world superpower (China) to work with an American government agency (the CIA) to hack voting machines using satellites. All to change *just enough* votes to win.
While this sounds like the worst movie plot you've ever heard of, it's our reality, and worst of all, the people entrusted to run our country actually believe it . That's why we need to do everything we can as private citizens to defend our fundamental right to vote from the gullible mob and their cynical leaders who are willing to lie and more to maintain their grip on power.
The future of our country and our citizens depends on what we can accomplish together. Step up with $35 or whatever you can today to defend voting rights, from mail-in ballots to early voting and beyond >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=030126_2&amount=35]

Peter, this is a
long but important email that we hope you’ll read to the end.

Donald Trump launched an illegal war against Iran yesterday while most of
us were asleep. The warmongering U.S. joined Israel’s genocidal government
in sabotaging peace talks and attacking Iran, sending missiles into
heavily populated communities and killing hundreds of civilians —
including over 100 children at an elementary school for girls.

From the safety of his Mar-a-Lago beach club, Trump callously told the
nation, “The lives of American heroes may be lost, and we may have
casualties. That often happens in war.”

His administration is using every excuse possible, from regime change to
nuclear weapons to protecting human rights, to justify this. But we know
the truth: this is an unnecessary act of unilateral aggression that
threatens to send our country into yet another endless war abroad.

The American people want health care, housing, and education — we don’t
want our tax dollars used to kill innocent people and fund more bottomless
Pentagon budgets for forever wars. While Justice Democrats in Congress
loudly and strongly oppose another forever war, Democratic Party
leadership is merely upset about Trump breaking protocol.

These strikes on Iran came after top Democratic leaders Rep. Hakeem
Jeffries and Sen. Chuck Schumer intentionally delayed a vote on Justice
Democrats Rep. Ro Khanna’s war powers resolution to stop Trump from
illegally declaring war without congressional approval. Exactly what AIPAC
wanted.

who invest in weapons manufacturers and take campaign checks from the
Israel lobby and the military industrial complex support this — they’re
just mad Trump didn’t let them vote on it first.

Why even have Democratic leadership — let's just give AIPAC the gavel.
What would be the difference?

The bipartisan warmongering is an absolute clown show, and it goes to show
how desperately we need to elect more progressive, anti-war Democrats who
will actually listen to the American people and unequivocally oppose this.

The 2026 Democratic primaries have already started, and we’re giving
everything we’ve got to send 12 progressive, pro-peace champions to

JD Vance put it clearly: That means: • Harder to stop China from cheating • Harder to bring jobs home • Harder to defend American steel, trucking, farming, and manufacturing In 2025 alone, tariffs generated BILLIONS in revenue. Companies were moving jobs back home. President Trump was even discussing tariff dividends for American families. Now? Back to foreign governments. Back to the same global cheaters who hollowed out our towns. We're fighting for an America that builds again. Factories lit up at sunrise. Steel poured on American soil. Georgia trucks hauling products stamped " Made in the USA." An America that rewards work -- not foreign cheating. This ruling doesn't just slow momentum, Here's what they don't understand. President Trump still has other tariff powers, and he will use them. But this fight just got bigger. And more political. That's why I'm running for the United States Senate. Because the Senate must be the FIREWALL for the America First agenda. If Democrats gain power, they won't just BLOCK tariffs. They'll DISMANTLE trade protections entirely. I will always stand for American workers. I will always fight unfair trade. And I will never bow to global interests. Then I'm asking you to stand up right now. For American industry. For our future. | | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

body:
| | | | Salem politicians are trying to move the vote. Stand with us to protect the voice of Oregon voters.

Dear Patriot,
Oregonians deserve transportation solutions that are affordable, responsible, and developed through true bipartisan cooperation. Unfortunately, that is not what happened in Salem.
Democratic lawmakers passed a multi-billion-dollar transportation package that raises gas taxes, vehicle registration and title fees, and payroll taxes — without meaningful Republican input. At a time when families are already feeling the strain of rising costs, this package adds yet another burden.
But Oregonians responded.
In record time and in record numbers, citizens from every walk of life signed petitions to refer this law to the ballot. When politicians would not listen, the people stepped forward. That is how our constitutional system is designed to work.
Now, instead of respecting that process, legislative leaders are attempting to move the vote from the November general election to the May primary — when far fewer Oregonians typically participate.
That’s not fairness. That’s political calculation.
If we are going to protect the voice of Oregon voters and stand for responsible governance, we need your help right now.
Will you make a contribution of $25, $50, $100, or whatever you are able to give today?
Your support will help us:
• Defend the integrity of the referendum process
• Educate voters about the real impact of this package
• Elect leaders committed to bipartisan, fiscally responsible solutions

clean_body: | | | | Salem politicians are trying to move the vote. Stand with us to protect the voice of Oregon voters. Dear Patriot, Oregonians deserve transportation solutions that are affordable, responsible, and developed through true bipartisan cooperation. Unfortunately, that is not what happened in Salem. Democratic lawmakers passed a multi-billion-dollar transportation package that raises gas taxes, vehicle registration and title fees, and payroll taxes — without meaningful Republican input. At a time when families are already feeling the strain of rising costs, this package adds yet another burden. But Oregonians responded. In record time and in record numbers, citizens from every walk of life signed petitions to refer this law to the ballot. When politicians would not listen, the people stepped forward. That is how our constitutional system is designed to work. Now, instead of respecting that process, legislative leaders are attempting to move the vote from the November general election to the May primary — when far fewer Oregonians typically participate. # An Update from the S.C. Senate

The General Assembly returned to Columbia on January 13 to begin the 2026 legislative session, and we continue to work through meaningful legislation designed to uphold South Carolina’s values, protect public safety, and ensure our state remains a strong place to live, work, and raise a family.

**SENATE REPUBLICANS SLASH TAXES**[**Homestead Exemption**](https://stephengoldfinch.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba0f7074263e985d5a29667c1&id=055940e6ba&e=3115da0ee7) _**Status: Passed the SC Senate**_
Last week, Republican Senators kept their promise to South Carolina seniors and voted to extend the homestead exemption to $150,000 for South Carolinians age 65 and up. This landmark legislation puts money back in the pockets of South Carolinians and delivers real relief for seniors. [Senate Bill 768](https://stephengoldfinch.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba0f7074263e985d5a29667c1&id=b8bd35c386&e=3115da0ee7) is projected to **cut taxes by more than $250 million** for South Carolina homeowners. The passage of this bill marks the first step in a broader tax-reform package.

[**Income Tax Reform**](https://stephengoldfinch.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba0f7074263e985d5a29667c1&id=57b706912c&e=3115da0ee7)
_**Status: Passed the SC Senate**_**
** _**Status: Sent back to the House with amendments**_
This legislation ([H.4216)](https://stephengoldfinch.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba0f7074263e985d5a29667c1&id=ffb8cd356b&e=3115da0ee7) restructures South Carolina’s income tax system to provide immediate relief while creating a responsible path toward lower rates over time. Individuals earning under $30,000 would pay a reduced 1.99% rate, while higher incomes would see a simplified top rate formula.
Future rate reductions are tied to strong revenue growth, meaning taxes only go down when the state can afford it. Over time, the goal is to continue lowering the income tax rate — potentially all the way to zero — while maintaining fiscal responsibility. The bill also simplifies how taxable income is calculated, making the system more straightforward for taxpayers.

_**Coming Up in The Senate - More Tax Relief Is on The Way**_
**Boat Property Tax Reform**
_**Status: Passed out of Senate Finance Committee**_

As a sponsor of this legislation ([S.317](https://stephengoldfinch.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba0f7074263e985d5a29667c1&id=9bb2e5dd53&e=3115da0ee7)), I introduced it to bring fairness and predictability to how boats are taxed in South Carolina. This bill would reduce the boat property tax in most counties from 10.5% to 6% and simplify the process by combining the boat and motor tax bills. Now that this bill has passed out of the full committee, it will be discussed on the Senate floor in the upcoming weeks.

_**Other Bills Passed by the Senate**_

**School Board Ethics** This legislation ([S.70](https://stephengoldfinch.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba0f7074263e985d5a29667c1&id=06a099af59&e=3115da0ee7)) strengthens ethics standards for local school board members, including charter school boards. It requires the State Board of Education to develop a model code of ethics and ensures local boards adopt those standards.
The bill also establishes mandatory training for school board members, including instruction on conflicts of interest and nepotism, to be completed within six months of taking office. The goal is simple: greater accountability and transparency in local school governance.

**Cracking Down on Child Sexual Abuse Material** This legislation ([S.723](https://stephengoldfinch.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba0f7074263e985d5a29667c1&id=84e341fcd3&e=3115da0ee7)) strengthens penalties for individuals convicted of sexual exploitation of a minor and possession of child sexual abuse material (CSAM). The bill raises mandatory minimum prison sentences, adds enhanced penalties for repeat offenders, and increases sentencing requirements based on the volume of illegal material possessed.
Those previously required to register as sex offenders would face additional mandatory prison time, and none of the minimum sentences could be suspended or made eligible for parole. The goal is clear: stronger consequences for those who exploit children and greater protection for victims.

**Name, Image, and Likeness in College Sports**
The Senate Education Committee recently heard testimony from athletic directors at Coastal Carolina, Clemson, and the University of South Carolina regarding the use of public funds in NIL and revenue-sharing agreements. They confirmed that no state-appropriated dollars are used for NIL contracts and noted that public disclosure of specific agreements could place schools at a competitive disadvantage.
Legislation addressing this issue has now passed the General Assembly and is awaiting the Governor’s signature. The bill ([H.4902)](https://stephengoldfinch.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba0f7074263e985d5a29667c1&id=64a7fdf262&e=3115da0ee7) requires public disclosure of the total amount an institution spends through a revenue-sharing program, while keeping payments to individual athletes and related negotiation documents confidential. This approach balances transparency for taxpayers with fairness and competitiveness for our universities.
**More Accountability for Charter Schools**

South Carolina’s charter schools need to preserve their flexibility but also need to provide transparency to taxpayers. The bill ([S.454](https://stephengoldfinch.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba0f7074263e985d5a29667c1&id=5afe392a64&e=3115da0ee7)) requires charter schools to publicly post key financial information and holds charter board members to the same ethics standards as other public officials. It also increases accountability for charter authorizers by requiring annual performance reports, clearer corrective action plans, and regular review by the Department of Education. The goal is simple: greater transparency, stronger oversight, and more confidence for parents and taxpayers.

**SC Safeguarding American Veterans’ Benefits Act**
This legislation ([S.695](https://stephengoldfinch.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba0f7074263e985d5a29667c1&id=fccbd473a6&e=3115da0ee7)) protects veterans from predatory actors who attempt to charge excessive or unlawful fees to help them access the benefits they have earned. It prohibits individuals from receiving compensation for advising or filing veterans’ benefit claims unless they are authorized under federal law. The bill also bans referral fees, false guarantees of benefit amounts, and unreasonable charges. Accredited representatives and certain licensed professionals are exempt, and any paid assistance must be clearly outlined in a written agreement. This effort helps ensure veterans receive honest guidance — not exploitation — when seeking the benefits they deserve.

**Honoring the Sacrifice of First Responders**
This legislation ([S.868](https://stephengoldfinch.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba0f7074263e985d5a29667c1&id=b5bc0c360c&e=3115da0ee7)) recognizes June 1 as “Gold Shield Day” to honor all first responders who have been killed in the line of duty.

name: Daniel Bunn, Tax Foundation
subject: Nothing is certain in life except death and taxes
body:
These words became an American Proverb.

|
---
| | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zi39pnp3bsm952q08k3dpg82p6eqstqp770m1848_rp22sh2s8i6epr2c5gm9oj6cth2bs)
* * *

Friend,

While writing to a friend, Benjamin Franklin said, _“Our new Constitution is now established, everything seems to promise it will be durable; but, in this world,**_nothing is certain except death and taxes_**.”_

These words became an American Proverb.

They captured the spirit of the age, when America fought and won its independence from the British Crown. Our fight for liberty was largely motivated by taxes, and we were willing to die for our liberty.

This year marks our nation’s 250th anniversary or semiquincentennial.

Where are we as a nation when it comes to taxation? Taxes are numerous, opaque, and complicated.

I don’t think our Founding Fathers would want it this way, nor do I believe it _ought_ to be this way. [We’re fighting to make big changes when it comes to taxation.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7vp8ejvku9736ljhl73r1u55qjrt5mmabepuvno_rp22sh2s8i6epr2c5gm9oj6cth2bs)

As President of Tax Foundation, my mission is to create a world where the tax code doesn’t stand in the way of success. And I personally believe this aligns with the Founders who risked their lives for this cause in 1776.
* [Simplicity](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z1br1kb3s4kbridrem0856q44p9dtta71ksejcag_rp22sh2s8i6epr2c5gm9oj6cth2bs): Tax codes should be easy for taxpayers to comply with and for governments to administer and enforce.

* [Transparency](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2l0h2doslup2u04roee26ublcr7g0cp1fqohvkg_rp22sh2s8i6epr2c5gm9oj6cth2bs): Tax policies should clearly and plainly define what taxpayers must pay and when they must pay it.

* [Neutrality](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3i6ov7stkd2phvle6lefmbkotgpifpslk3rmj88_rp22sh2s8i6epr2c5gm9oj6cth2bs): Taxes should neither encourage nor discourage personal or business decisions.

* [Stability](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zak3gh2kfeqilhbcfa9bgnoud11q2e237nc3432o_rp22sh2s8i6epr2c5gm9oj6cth2bs): Taxpayers deserve consistency and predictability in the tax code.

Friend, this isn’t just my dream.

My team of tax experts is making this a reality by meeting with lawmakers, decision-makers, and the media every day to improve lives through tax policies that drive greater economic growth and opportunity.

Let me be frank. I know this isn’t as exciting as the culture wars you see online or on CNN or Fox News. **But beyond a doubt, this will affect your life more than any single issue.**

As Ben Franklin once said, _“Nothing is certain except death and taxes!”_

[I am asking you to join our mission at Tax Foundation. Your support will help drive our nation’s tax policy. Please join us today by making a tax-deductible gift of $10, $17.76, $50, $250, or any amount.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zih775hs2cc7qsqaf551pa9calmgik41p2tj0asg_rp22sh2s8i6epr2c5gm9oj6cth2bs)

While we’ll never get rid of taxes (or death), let’s make taxes as simple and transparent as possible.

For America!

Daniel Bunn
President and CEO
Tax Foundation

| | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE March 2, 2026
Former Attorney General Bill Schuette Endorses Doug Lloyd Ahead of GOP Endorsement Convention
Schuette: "Doug Lloyd has all the right ingredients: Experience, integrity and strong work ethic"
LANSING, MI - With Republican delegates set to endorse the party's nominee for Attorney General, former Michigan Attorney General Bill Schuette today announced his endorsement of Doug Lloyd, citing Lloyd's proven record as a prosecutor and his experience as a strong partner during Schuette's tenure as Attorney General.
Schuette served as Attorney General while Lloyd was prosecuting cases as Eaton County Prosecutor, giving him firsthand experience working with Lloyd on law enforcement and public safety matters.
"I know Doug Lloyd," Schuette said. "During my service as Michigan's Attorney General, Doug was a strong partner who enforced the law, protected victims, and approached the job with professionalism and honor. Doug has great experience, is a person of integrity and works tremendously hard. Doug has all the right ingredients. He understands the role of Attorney General and has what it takes to lead the office on day one. Michigan needs an experienced AG. We cannot afford any on the job training."
Lloyd has served as Eaton County Prosecutor for more than a decade, handling serious criminal cases, advocating for crime victims, using an iron hand against human trafficking and working collaboratively with state and local law enforcement. His service has spanned multiple administrations and earned him the respect of prosecutors and law enforcement leaders across Michigan.
"I am honored to earn Attorney General Bill Schuette's endorsement," Lloyd said. "He knows what this office demands and worked with me while serving as Michigan's chief law enforcement officer. Michigan Republicans deserve a nominee who is ready to lead, defend the rule of law, and win in November. I am ready for that responsibility."
Schuette's endorsement underscores Lloyd's readiness to serve as Attorney General and reinforces his standing as a trusted, experienced leader as delegates prepare to vote at the Republican endorsement convention.
For more information about Doug Lloyd's campaign for Attorney General, visit [www.votedouglloyd.com](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001bMGGBDdpIytytCym6_rdpOGBgqsy3OmOG1ajupVKnpuHrBUNiJsZTbvJSkc4zN7KuPePkewaiFmUjXfeI4H3aniq2YWUW0nWfntg-brbEclTZ7YkOqJsRDiLbqIvV5bxHCYMSv26h8L6xfXkk8FCxH-zobEiVEGZOpPc69gWTzA=&c=XHXtj-RZ5Nu_w1V2G9qEI8uLn6fqd0nWIdb9IefKypBKRHv4jAjQhg==&ch=RG3pU0AKpdFT-rTTFPG917dAD-Ndac-k2feQCxa57wyz6DFqxGUSOw==).

Schuette served as Attorney General while Lloyd was prosecuting cases as Eaton County Prosecutor, giving him firsthand experience working with Lloyd on law enforcement and public safety matters. "I know Doug Lloyd," Schuette said. "During my service as Michigan's Attorney General, Doug was a strong partner who enforced the law, protected victims, and approached the job with professionalism and honor. Doug has great experience, is a person of integrity and works tremendously hard. Doug has all the right ingredients. He understands the role of Attorney General and has what it takes to lead the office on day one. Michigan needs an experienced AG. We cannot afford any on the job training." Lloyd has served as Eaton County Prosecutor for more than a decade, handling serious criminal cases, advocating for crime victims, using an iron hand against human trafficking and working collaboratively with state and local law enforcement. His service has spanned multiple administrations and earned him the respect of prosecutors and law enforcement leaders across Michigan. "I am honored to earn Attorney General Bill Schuette's endorsement," Lloyd said. "He knows what this office demands and worked with me while serving as Michigan's chief law enforcement officer. Michigan Republicans deserve a nominee who is ready to lead, defend the rule of law, and win in November. I am ready for that responsibility." Schuette's endorsement underscores Lloyd's readiness to serve as Attorney General and reinforces his standing as a trusted, experienced leader as delegates prepare to vote at the Republican endorsement convention. ---
Riedel Campaign Update | March 2, 2026
---
Riedel Campaign Receives Endorsements from Five Ohio Senators
---
|
---
|
On Monday, February 23 the Riedel campaign received endorsements from Ohio Senate Leaders. Riedel was endorsed by President Pro Tempore Bill Reineke (R-Tiffin), Majority Floor Leader Theresa Gavarone (R-Bowling Green), and Majority Whip George Lang (R-West Chester). Senator Reineke issued the following statement on Riedel:
"Ohio needs decisive leaders with the vision and drive to deliver results. Craig Riedel has an exceptional private sector background and brings an outsider's approach to Columbus. Northwest Ohio should continue to have a strong conservative representing the 1st Senate District, and that's why I am proud to endorse Craig Riedel."
Last week, Riedel also announced endorsements from two additional Ohio Senators, Mark Romanchuk and Susan Manchester. All five of the senators who issued endorsements have previously served with Craig in the Ohio House of Representatives and know he is the conservative leader that Northwest Ohio needs in Columbus. As support continues to grow around the Riedel campaign, Craig is encouraged and continues to work hard everyday.
---
|
---
| Riedel Campaign Hosts Two Fundraising Events The Riedel campaign hosted two fundraisers over the past month within the 1st Senate District. The first fundraiser of the new year was held in Findlay, followed by the second event in Kenton. At both events, Craig delivered remarks to supporters about what he hopes to accomplish as the next senator for District 1. Craig and Danette continue to be extremely grateful for the outpouring of support that they have received from people all across the 1st Senate District.
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| Riedel Campaign Receives Two More Endorsements from Conservative Groups
---
| |
---
Over the past month, the Riedel campaign has received endorsements from both the Right to Life Action Coalition of Ohio and Ohio Conservatives PAC. As the Riedel campaign continues working hard everyday, the support from both conservative voters and groups have mounted growing momentum heading into the Spring. These two most recent endorsements show the continued trust that conservatives have in Riedel to deliver for the people of the 1st Senate District.
Craig has been incredibly honored to receive the support of conservative groups from all across Ohio. Riedel's proven record on standing up for life, reducing taxes, shrinking government, and protecting the 2nd amendment have made him the clear choice for voters in the 1st Senate District.
---
| |
---
| | Craig Speaks at Candidate Forums
Over the past month, Craig enjoyed the opportunity to speak to voters at candidate forums in Putnam and Hancock Counties. Craig laid out his positive vision for Ohio and what he hopes to accomplish for the people of the 1st Senate District.
---
|
---
| |
---
| |
---
| | Riedel Campaign Announces Impressive Fundraising Haul
This month, the Riedel campaign announced another strong campaign finance filing. Since entering the race, the Riedel campaign has raised more than $418,000 from supporters. Riedel has raised 60% more than his opponent in the race, and is poised for victory on May 5th. Craig and Danette are extremely grateful for the trust and support that they have received since launching the campaign last April.
---
| | |
---
| |
---
|
# Craig Attends Rotary Club Meetings Throughout the 1st Senate District

As a proud Rotarian and member of the Defiance Rotary Club, Craig has jumped at the opportunity to visit Rotary Clubs all across the 1st Senate District. Over the past month, Craig attended Rotary Club meetings in Archbold and Findlay. Craig appreciates all that the different clubs do to impact their individual communities throughout Northwest Ohio.
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
|
### Craig and Danette Attend Paulding Kiwanis Club

Last month, Craig and Danette were happy to attend the Paulding Kiwanis Club. Craig spoke to the group and answered questions about his background and how to move Ohio forward in the coming years. Craig appreciated the opportunity to address the group and catch up with friends from Paulding County
---
| |
---
| |
---
| | Riedel Campaign Continues Strong Ground Game
Since moving into the door knocking phase of the campaign in September, the Riedel campaign has knocked on nearly 13,000 doors to reach voters all across the 1st Senate District. While meeting voters at the door, Craig has been extremely encouraged by the kind words and support that he has received from the people of Northwest Ohio.

## Iran Strikes Back as US Bombing Continues
President Trump said on Sunday that U.S. operations in Iran were ahead of schedule and that American forces had destroyed and sunk nine Iranian naval ships as Iran launched retaliatory missile and drone attacks across the region. [Watch the video here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFugzAQxvGngS3R-bAxGTxUqtjSqVJHdMHn4NZgZF8S5e2r9BW6fp_0G_5f5-lMMcXt-kErOwl52vhRE4twmWKhrUqJP1xDLFVKvmQJMa0TAvYH6A6Ak6eYnpNuvQvMyF3LTlmL2oDRpl2c8QrAzKZnGqDHwKeevO_IagoKybbRvTToAJVCRH0MA81AcLE029MA3GhgHyWX43eOmywc0jPfuRznvLbJLSJ7bbq3BscGRyk3WWqeI6XX_xo1FKb0njdK_rPc1r3Bcc9VaoOjUr0y5mSUtoO2XQ9DW5zfHzGlWHvbaLiuFP-oVv7V5-7wNwAA___5TXg_). U.S. Central Command said three American service members were killed, while Israel reported at least eight killed in Beit Shemesh after a missile hit a residential area, and Gulf states, including the United Arab Emirates and Kuwait, reported deaths and injuries from strikes. [Follow live updates here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOqzAQheGnMV3QMBgMhYvb0OW2W6LBjJPZNThrRkF5-1X2FbY-0ied_-M6X0mS7Lf_tLHXmOedzyOxKpdZCu2HFvniI0o5tOQla5S0zQjYX6C9AM4rSXrNtlp9ZEZuK_aNc2g76GxX3f0aYaRh6EeyTLblgR3FFSmEMDZDHCvxbw1awKZBRFvHgQIQLI6CGwdgY4FX0Vzqzyy73jmmV35yqUPequTvqo_DtP8MTgan8zzrZQnvzeD0PmNwSvJkg1PYuxuP3Xf_cloVvz5OSUmO3hkLt40k_Yr6pwxPjz8BAAD__7k1ce0). Iranian officials said Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei was killed Saturday and said an interim leadership council was named as the country moved toward selecting a new leader. Meanwhile, hundreds of Iranian Americans gathered in Midtown Manhattan on Sunday to celebrate Khamenei's reported death and thank the U.S. and Israel for the strikes, with photos showing crowds waving Iranian and American flags and marching toward Times Square. [See photos here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAQRL_GZD0yDQxM4OASsr30QtSD29A3xh7Zvbvi70_sL1xSSame9OrPx_JBEiVtv-lgpyEvib9rZFUuixRKVYu8uAYpVUt-Zg0SjwUt3sF2YHHxJPFc-sa7wIzcNezaccR-sEM_NLuzjzCNLWJLNPA60eN-90g8TNQN7Wi7RtxFs53FtkXE_hYmWi3Z50jr-Jgsm96yF83l9jdL0p1DPPMXl9uajya6XfVdTffL4GxwTuc7V70qg_MFNjjb7orW4PxZ4fIzOO-fyRf2FXKAy1MoAR1cZKVUIUiMkM4VqhZmraAZVo78LKQMnkn3a0gnaY6RdnjtdHBigYNe_AOErTAp0EaSDM5Ncf79LTFKvY-mt9tBEn8M9L9u_3L4LwAA__9Mbpi6).
## Austin Bar Shooting Probed as Terrorism
A gunman [opened fire](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkMHO2yAQhJ8G34jwAiY5cKhU-fb3UlU9Whu8JNsfGwu2SfP2VfoKvc5Io_m-nx_LB3Lh_fYNN4qS67LTsxcSobZww71L40_qmVuXVq9VMpdtAQOTNlYbWFbk8lrcsMZMBGQHimMI4Lzxzg_3CBea1jE4j5ARk7eW7Jg8QV7PwWc_cHyvGWtgHAHAnfIZk0FzDZjC5WxIOUMrS22nX5V3uVMur_qgdkp1G0q8ixxd2S8KZgUzXtOb4N0pmH98f0dJ-EEaRTB96oSlaPzdhXd9tLod0jVt1G60p5du1I-6d9JCf7ArmLvU9lJ25lXZr6M1k5vCeBlaXI8nl8J9CsqZ24Zc_v2R_5L4iPA3AAD__61Gh4k) outside Buford's Backyard Beer Garden on famed Sixth Street in Austin, Texas, early Sunday, killing two and wounding 14 before police fatally shot him. The suspect was wearing a "Property of Allah" hoodie and was possibly out for [vengeance over the U.S. attack on Iran](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAMhp8mdB4FA5uhoLiGbq-9EoXg7Pg2kLnYzIi3P-Ve4RpLlqXP___9-lw-PSc-vn76nSaNeTnoLYlUqSxc_CFa-JskchEtec0aOe0LWvwA24HFZfOcrqVvtikSIXUNTa1z2A926IfmMbnOuntwo7_3YwgjDa5v3Tq05GIYaMSGp0qzncW2RcT-Fu8-WG9X54Mb75ZMb2ljzeX2O_OhD4rpyi8qt5D3Jk0P1aeY7ofB2eB8XM8sWk8G5wo2ONuujtbgfArUfgZnf4ryAbsXAXnkrFTgmUV4TRfsWfnllTZYL6gWwKv68C3w56xbzOexAR8QfAEvEFcGukhAqZRcWOrzpkzb880psXw409uv3XP6l1n_S_Rrwr8BAAD__2v3lBw), law-enforcement sources said. A Quran was also found in his vehicle. The 53-year-old naturalized U.S. citizen from Senegal drove an SUV around the block before firing from the window, then exited and continued shooting. Officers stationed nearby responded within a minute. The FBI has launched a terrorism investigation, and Gov. Greg Abbott has activated the Texas National Guard.
## First Robot in Cinema Found in Long-Lost Film
The Library of Congress has [found and restored](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOqzAQheGnMR1oGAxOChe3octtt0TGDGF2jY3sUVDefhVeYesj_dJ3vh7Tw3Hg-PzvdrKypinSWQKJUJ44u1gk8w-VlXORnOYkK4d9QsChhq4GnBbH4T3parErEVJXkW2NQd1Dr_tqs-393qEmvLkBYNbOm27xS4_zQGB8P1dsPzXoANsWEXWz3pwHB7Nx3txvQEoDLSwpN9-Jo2y0hnd6UW582qtgN5GjqO6fwlHheJ5nc6SjeP7MCkchv8UU0vOtcLwY9eWoU6w_FoVjle1ynBwCl8EoDc_dcbjq8qdLXhZ_AwAA___vo3aS) what it believes is the first depiction of a robot in cinema: a 45-second silent film by pioneering French filmmaker Georges Melies from around 1897, more than 20 years before the word "robot" was even coined. In _Gugusse and the Automaton_ , Melies plays a stage performer who winds up a small automaton on a pedestal. On this day in 1962, Wilt Chamberlain scored 100 points in a basketball game for the Philadelphia Warriors. He remains the only NBA player to hit the century mark, and he did it before the advent of the three-pointer. () The Library of Congress has restored a long-lost from around 1897 that it believes features cinema's first robot, complete with a bit of old-school mischief. Today's sponsor, , invites you to share the hope of Easter by providing Easter Bags filled with small gifts and the message of Christ's love to children and families in some of America's toughest neighborhoods. | Iran Strikes Back as US Bombing Continues President Trump said on Sunday that U.S. operations in Iran were ahead of schedule and that American forces had destroyed and sunk nine Iranian naval ships as Iran launched retaliatory missile and drone attacks across the region. . U.S. Central Command said three American service members were killed, while Israel reported at least eight killed in Beit Shemesh after a missile hit a residential area, and Gulf states, including the United Arab Emirates and Kuwait, reported deaths and injuries from strikes. . Iranian officials said Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei was killed Saturday and said an interim leadership council was named as the country moved toward selecting a new leader. Meanwhile, hundreds of Iranian Americans gathered in Midtown Manhattan on Sunday to celebrate Khamenei's reported death and thank the U.S. and Israel for the strikes, with photos showing crowds waving Iranian and American flags and marching toward Times Square. . Austin Bar Shooting Probed as Terrorism A gunman outside Buford's Backyard Beer Garden on famed Sixth Street in Austin, Texas, early Sunday, killing two and wounding 14 before police fatally shot him. The suspect was wearing a "Property of Allah" hoodie and was possibly out for , law-enforcement sources said. A Quran was also found in his vehicle. The 53-year-old naturalized U.S. citizen from Senegal drove an SUV around the block before firing from the window, then exited and continued shooting. Officers stationed nearby responded within a minute. The FBI has launched a terrorism investigation, and Gov. Greg Abbott has activated the Texas National Guard. First Robot in Cinema Found in Long-Lost Film The Library of Congress has what it believes is the first depiction of a robot in cinema: a 45-second silent film by pioneering French filmmaker Georges Melies from around 1897, more than 20 years before the word "robot" was even coined. In Gugusse and the Automaton , Melies plays a stage performer who winds up a small automaton on a pedestal. The machine grows, does a little dance, then . Melies retaliates with a comically large hammer, bashing it smaller and smaller until it vanishes. The film had been presumed lost for over a century. It turned up in a box of old reels driven to the Library by a whose great-grandfather, a Pennsylvania potato farmer and traveling showman, had collected them before World War I. It's now available to on the Library's website. ## Austin Bar Targeted in Potential Terrorist Attack
A gunman killed two people and wounded 14 others at a downtown Austin bar early Sunday. The [mass shooting](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0Dtu8zAQBODTSN0KFCnrUbD4G3X-25QCH0trEUo0yLVl3T5wgpwg9QCD-ebjulwNRdpv_82Gml8hLTseJSIz5sU8CtNe1pSY9ps1Maa0U-GySCF7EAqEXLyheC5d7bUVfmpr1O0wyO4ip2mqV62UctMo-2DDOPSuUwqHfhrRWe-6fhxr0u8yoYRspVDtpfGX1tlJDWF0QbZWVZ1AT5xywysyvkwJ8UxPzI1LWx31ynwvlfpXybmS83EcTUivt-KdV3J-lErOHo2PJ_xagHb40QGvhuGTYkQPCjZzgkUwjiEFYMw5ZSobBEtQzFnqrP39oBip9EPVidtmKH4P4b_d99TyKwAA__9crodU) was "potentially an act of terrorism," according to the FBI. The suspect, 53-year-old Ndiaga Diagne, targeted patrons at Buford's Backyard Beer Garden on West Sixth Street shortly before 2 a.m., [circling the establishment](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkMGOpCAURb8Gdxh4KJYLFrNxV7OdpUF56MsgGKGLqr_vVHf6C3p9k5tzzr_7fLcUKG5_7YGmPH2aI9YcsBS8ZvuRC8W8p1QobosNIaVIueQZBGguFBcwO0vhNXeNM4two2zQyGGArodxHJvdKK90v1jh9M0r0F2Pa4eLRi1H1cteNmTeZ0IJkCCU7FvXy3UZ1eBvqwe5KNYJdFTS1ZYdCz5t9uGVHni1azqaYPZSzszUHwYTg6nW2v5_2vgeGUxvGwbTetGBDKYT0xmQO7SO-xRCqhQ3ftic-Y8mp8hdqrGkGvl3AQZTcxl3VgqBsh5YJ7bDUvgCKL_L9jDwGQAA___ODoQW) in an SUV before opening fire with a pistol. He was killed by police after getting out of the vehicle with a rifle. Diagne, a naturalized U.S. citizen [from Senegal](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuwyAQhp8Gb1hwYGMGhi7e0rWjhQ3EqAQic46Tt68ctU_Q7ZNO-k7f_3WZLjammK-f9uYNPkOZsj9q8oh-m-xeMea6loIxX2ebUik5VqwTMOgpE5TB5GxMr0k2zszMad54w5UC2YHWulmN7qVWYfDMCqeCVYMO0IH0lksANrAmmlPGBAMOTPCudR1fZi1UGJYAfBZEMu8ilq3F1aN_2hrSqzz81i7l1iSzIt4rER8ERgLjcRxtnpez4rwTGE8kMO6V_tJfEH3L6Gw3Wvd69wvS75iSd3RbsoWec62azbj7EVOKtVdEsuvNxvR-jP-b62HgJwAA__9I_YAr), was reportedly wearing a sweatshirt that said "Property of Allah" and an undershirt featuring an Iranian flag. Authorities executed a search warrant at a residence in Pflugerville after the shooting. "_Obviously it's still way too early in the process to determine an exact motivation, but there were indicators on the subject and in his vehicle that indicate potential nexus to terrorism_ ," [said Alex Doran](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGO5CAQRU-DM1pQYLsdEGzibDbd0Cqg6EZDQ8vUtGduv_Ks9gST1lN9_ff_vG1vmEuut9_4IMefqW2Vjl6ImfYNPzrn2u-tca43j6W0VnPnvoGCSSojFWwRc_na7BCdV3HRAzk9z2BHWJZluDs0Vs94naz343VEbYKe5ylQwuD1GGjI7gxTRoEGZfR4iaMOfjFzuoYE2hthFcXMbb_wnZg-safy1V60X0J7DMXdmZ9dmF8CVgHrcRyX99cHnVDAijvnUEjAenoJWEsLWE7w7SYf2Lv8b3ieA-cXSWTG8C53eradKcpcZWxH5XZU-e9TwArTIjXqJdgJpLZ6ktboSV6jRzkbCGYZk08hDbuLzyOXkvs0C6tuD8zluzz_bPKXg78BAAD__x5elgM), acting special agent in charge of the FBI's San Antonio Field Office.

Listen to our daily 15-minute podcast while commuting, cooking, or walking the dog—your Flyover fix, anywhere. | | Austin Bar Targeted in Potential Terrorist Attack A gunman killed two people and wounded 14 others at a downtown Austin bar early Sunday. The was "potentially an act of terrorism," according to the FBI. The suspect, 53-year-old Ndiaga Diagne, targeted patrons at Buford's Backyard Beer Garden on West Sixth Street shortly before 2 a.m., in an SUV before opening fire with a pistol. He was killed by police after getting out of the vehicle with a rifle. Diagne, a naturalized U.S. citizen , was reportedly wearing a sweatshirt that said "Property of Allah" and an undershirt featuring an Iranian flag. Authorities executed a search warrant at a residence in Pflugerville after the shooting. "Obviously it's still way too early in the process to determine an exact motivation, but there were indicators on the subject and in his vehicle that indicate potential nexus to terrorism ," , acting special agent in charge of the FBI's San Antonio Field Office. Dramatic Hot Air Balloon Rescue Firefighters from multiple agencies from a hot air balloon after it collided with a cell phone tower in Longview on Saturday. The collision occurred at 8:15 a.m. at a height of 920 feet. The firefighters began climbing the tower around 8:50 a.m. and about an hour later, using multiple rope systems due to the extreme height and complexity of the incident. The balloon's occupants and made it safely to the ground about four hours after the rescue operation began. Upshur County Constable Tim Barnett described the courage of the firefighters who rescued the balloonists as "nothing short of extraordinary." On Saturday, the US and Israel mounted full-scale military strikes on Iran. Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei and dozens of his top military leaders were killed; a meeting of top staff may have been the catalyst for the timing of the strikes.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b3024962-dfd1-49d6-807c-eeadcadd70e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The response has been all over the map. Democrats focused on the lack of Congressional approval and the absence of a plan. Many people from every party called up Trump's 2024 campaign language of avoiding costly new wars while the American people have other concerns. There was some evidence that Iran was exerting itself to try to agree to American conditions before the strikes began.
I'll confess to having a range of reactions myself.
The Khamanei regime brutally killed tens of thousands of its own citizens in the last several months in response to widspread protests. I wrote [recently](https://substack.com/redirect/196ef541-3d78-4860-b2e6-faf8a91014d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that I hoped that America did everything in its power to topple the regime, which has been the source of myriad terrible actions for decades, including plotting the killing of dissidents that lived in America, one of whom I interviewed.
The protests in Iran were fueled by inflation and impoverishment; the currency lost 80% of its value this year alone and water rationing and power outages are the norm. The regime also savagely oppresses girls and women. Internationally, Iran sponsored terrorist groups like Hamas and Hezbollah.
"There's no world in which we're better off with Khamanei in it," is the way analyst Ian Bremmer put it. I agree. Iran's nuclear aspirations are a thing of the past. That is also great news for the world.
"Take over your government," Trump is now urging the people of Iran. "It will be yours to take." This is going to be very difficult. The people of Iran are essentially unarmed. Tens of thousands of protesters, some of whom would have been potential leaders, have already been killed. There remains a well-developed underground network of Iranians who despise the current government and have been fueling the resistance; this network has managed to maintain communication even while evading constant surveillance. But the remaining leaders of the Islamic Republic will have their own survival at stake and are experienced now at suppressing internal efforts to oust them.
There is also Reza Pahlavi, the son of the Shah who was removed back in 1979. Reza doesn't have a ton of relationships within Iran given that he hasn't been there for decades, but he will be the face of the dissidents abroad who are desperate to move on from the Islamic Republic.
Still, one Iranian who is celebrating Khamanei's death said, "We have felt entirely alone. Now we know that we are not."
This military action has been an enormous gamble, and some of the costs are already real. Hundreds of innocent civilians and at least 3 U.S. soldiers have died in the conflict. Iran's retaliation has included attacks in the region on completely unaffiliated actors in addition to U.S. and Israeli bases.
The major questions lie ahead: How long will the strikes continue? Does the conflict spread? Who will become the new leader of the Islamic Republic, and what stance will they take? What is the follow through? Early signs are that new Iranian leadership has already reached out to Trump and wants to negotiate a cessation of conflict even while signaling escalation in the region. The likely scenario is that Khamanei gets replaced by someone within the Islamic Republic senior ranks who is younger and of similar bent. One Iranian compared the current regime to a hydra; if you cut off one head another like it will appear.
Whether the strikes result in something more positive remains to be seen. But an evil dictator who led the killing and starvation of his own people and sponsored terrorist organizations is dead. The Iranian people have at least some chance for a better way of life, one that didn't exist before. Some hope is better than none.
