name: Ilhan Omar
subject: End this needless war
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2114%2E791427%2E3x2qPA)
Trump has launched an illegal regime change war with Iran.
As someone who has survived the horrors of war, I know military aggression does not make us safer; it only inflames tensions and pushes the world further into chaos. We’re already seeing the devastating and destabilizing effects.
Airstrikes and drone attacks have landed in Iran, Israel, Kuwait, the UAE, Lebanon, Saudi Arabia, Iraq, Bahrain, Qatar, and Cyprus. Military personnel and civilians have been killed, including American soldiers. The death toll will soon be in the thousands if this war continues.
And for what? What is Trump’s long-term plan here? Absolutely nothing. We have killed Iran’s Ayatollah as well as much of its senior leadership. Trump is telling Iranians to rise up and protest while American and Israeli bombs drop over their heads. We are creating the kind of instability that leads to civil war, terrorism, and economic ruin under the guise of promoting security and democracy.
And of course, the American people don’t want this. Americans saw what happened in Iraq and Afghanistan and we have learned the failures of regime-change wars built on false promises and paid for with American and foreign lives. Trump saw this and ran on ending needless wars and opposing aggressive US intervention, only to quickly prove that was a lie of gigantic proportions. That lie will be costly.
While Republicans are slashing people’s healthcare and defunding critical programs like Medicaid and food assistance, they have no trouble spending billions of dollars of our taxpayer money on violence abroad. As always, the defense contractors get rich while the American people hold the bill.
I’m going to do everything I can to fight for peace and diplomacy and assert Congressional authority over the President’s reckless actions, but I need your help.
Join me in raising our collective voices against war, against needless killing, and for the path of peace. We have to make it clear that Trump and the Republicans will pay a price for bringing us down the path of war.
In solidarity,
Ilhan Omar

That's why we're joining together tonight for an emergency mass call with allies including MoveOn, 50501, and Win Without War to learn how we can take action. We’ll hear from activists, foreign policy experts, and members of Congress who are calling for immediate de-escalation in Iran and demanding swift action to rein in Trump. Then read below to learn about more ways to take action. — Team WFP \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Team WFP Date: Sun, Mar 1, 2026 Subject: Add your name: Stop this war Peter, Donald Trump, alongside Benjamin Netanyahu, has launched an illegal war against Iran without either Congressional authorization or the support of the American people. These actions are putting working families, both in the United States and abroad, in increasing danger. The Iranian people deserve self-determination, freedom, dignity, and security for their families. That can only come through a coherent diplomatic strategy, not the haphazard and reckless use of military force. The U.S. government has already spent decades enmeshed in wars in the region, costing trillions of taxpayer dollars, and resulting in the deaths of hundreds of thousands of people.1 Each war has ended up making us less safe and the region less stable. That's why poll after poll shows the vast majority of Americans opposing this war, including many within the MAGA coalition.2 This war can and must be stopped before it escalates further. We are counting on our elected representatives to act now. The Court ruled to BLOCK the Democrats' scheme to redraw our district and RESTORED the existing lines. Their plan to eliminate New York City's only Republican seat has been STOPPED. But let's be clear about what just happened: radical Democrats tried to use the courts to overturn YOUR vote and erase your representation in Congress. They weren't interested in fairness — they wanted to gerrymander me out of existence because they can't beat me at the ballot box. Friend,

By striking Iran, President Trump has lied to the American people and dragged us into a dangerous conflict with grave consequences.

It should go without saying that Congress is a coequal branch of government. But once again, Trump has defied the Constitution and is moving our country toward war in the Middle East.

We cannot wade into another deadly and costly conflict -- not like this, and especially not while millions of working families at home are struggling to make ends meet.

I want you to know I’m in full support of the War Powers Resolution. It would require the President to receive Congressional approval for committing armed forces for military action -- and avoid the unilateral action we’re seeing now.

When it’s brought to the House floor, I will be voting yes. We need a check on this president.

My thoughts are with the safety and well-being of our service members and all those in the region.

She pulled in over half a million dollars from liberal donors across the country with one goal in mind: to defeat me, defeat President Trump, and defeat everything we’ve fought for together. Democrats know that South Carolina is a firewall for the conservative movement. If they can win here, they believe they can weaken the American First agenda nationwide. That’s why they are flooding South Carolina with liberal dollars - the money is pouring in from Hollywood liberals, coastal activists, and out-of-state donors who don’t share our values. Chuck Schumer and Senate Democrats want to replace me with someone who will be a rubber stamp for their radical agenda - and worse - someone who will block President Trump at every turn. Fellow American, I’ve never taken a race for granted, and I am not about to start now. But if we’re going to fight back against the radical left and this wave of outside money, I know that might not sound like a lot when my opponent is raising half a million a month, but it adds up. # [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
Tomorrow, Texas Democrats will choose their nominee for the next Governor.
And the day after that? We’re taking on Abbott.
**[We’re in the final 24 hours of this primary, and I need every supporter standing with me. Will you chip in $5 to help us finish strong?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260302_3_countdown.xcJ8dV&refcode=em20260302-686&amount=5&t=1&akid=686%2E299639%2Ew2Vh-K)**

Here’s where we stand: We’ve received the endorsement of every major newspaper in Texas. We’re polling only 3 points behind Abbott — the same margin that sent Ann Richards to office. We just watched Democrat Taylor Rehmet flip a deep-red Senate district by 14 points.
**Everything is in our favor to win. And it all starts with this election.**
When tomorrow comes it is critical we carry this momentum — that even Abbott’s warchest can’t deny — through November. Abbott and the Republicans are watching this race closely. He knows whoever wins the Democratic primary will be a major threat, and he’s ready to attack.

Tomorrow, when the polls open, hundreds of thousands of voters will use their ballot to say who they want to be the next Governor. And I’m ready.
Your vote has power. Power to elect leaders who will fight for our communities, our rights, and our future.

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: We can afford bombs — but not care?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Billions for bombs. “No money” for health care.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260302-5964-footer&t=1&akid=5964%2E420207%2E3YGFc2)
Pramila Jayapal here.
We’re constantly told that Medicare for All is “too expensive.”
That canceling student debt costs too much.
That guaranteeing housing, child care, or paid leave just isn’t “realistic.”
**But somehow, there is always money for war.**
Billions of dollars spent overnight to drop bombs on school children. Blank checks written without hesitation for weapons manufacturers and defense contractors.
No one asks how we’re going to “pay for it” when it comes to military escalation.
Let’s be honest about what this means.
It means our political system is rigged to prioritize endless war over human needs. It means Congress debates health care for months — but wars are started overnight. It means working families are told to tighten their belts while corporations that profit from war see their stock prices soar in an instant.
**That is a moral failure.**
Instead of spending trillions on never-ending wars, we can provide universal, comprehensive health care for all. Instead of funding bombs, we can fund schools. Instead of bankrolling military contractors, we can invest in working people.
The question isn’t whether we have the money.
The question is who our government chooses to serve.
I don’t take corporate PAC money. I don’t answer to war profiteers or defense contractors. I answer to working people who have the most to lose from another endless war — and the most to gain from a government that invests in them.
If you’re ready to build an economy that funds care instead of conflict, I’m asking you to stand with me.
[**Can you chip in $10 or anything you can today to help power this movement?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260302.18ieY9&refcode=em20260302-5964&amount=3&t=2&akid=5964%2E420207%2E3YGFc2)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260302.18ieY9&amount=3&refcode=em20260302-5964&t=21&akid=5964%2E420207%2E3YGFc2)**
We deserve a government that prioritizes life, dignity, and opportunity — not endless war.
In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal
**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-footer?refcode=em20260302-5964-footer&t=22&refcode2=5964_420207_3YGFc2&akid=5964%2E420207%2E3YGFc2)**

Mark Levin just went nuclear, and he asked a question we can no longer ignore: **
**_**"You ready, America?"**_
**Because what's happening in Texas isn't just a state issue anymore – it’s becoming Ground Zero in the battle for Western civilization.** _
_**All across Europe, countries are rapidly losing their identities as a result of unfettered mass migration with no assimilation.** **
** Parallel societies have begun to emerge and they are incompatible – one based upon Western, Judeo-Christian values, and one based upon Sharia Law, or Islamic Law.
**You could say this is just a European problem, but Sharia is the primary driver of Christian persecution across the planet, and it’s begun to gain a foothold right here in America.** **_
_** On a recent show, a retired Texas police lieutenant blew the whistle directly to Levin._**He revealed details about EPIC City – a proposed Sharia-compliant "Islamic mega-city" being planned on roughly 400 acres in Texas.** Critics claim it's designed to function separately from American society, operating under Sharia principles rather than U.S. law._ _
___Mark's response was unequivocal:__ __
______**“Sharia Law has no place in the United States of America.”**____ ____**

body:
Over the weekend, President Trump announced the start of massive and ongoing military operations against Iran.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126503382/605090016/-201694504?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZjRjM2MwYS03OTE2LWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2ExZjBhOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FgWbls8ahiTrw2zSt-mKkc5o170vgqPRz8U3RgmS-QE=&emci=df6a8ab2-6916-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&emdi=5f4c3c0a-7916-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&ceid=9494239)

| | Over the weekend, President Trump announced the start of massive and ongoing military operations against Iran. I joined Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries and the New Democrat Coalition to release statements on U.S. strikes against Iran. **Here is the statement from Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries:** _"Overnight, Donald Trump announced the start of massive and ongoing military operations against Iran. The framers of the United States Constitution gave Congress the sole power to declare war as the branch of government closest to the American people._ _"Iran is a bad actor and must be aggressively confronted for its human rights violations, nuclear ambitions, support of terrorism and the threat it poses to our allies like Israel and Jordan in the region. However, absent exigent circumstances, the Trump administration must seek authorization for the preemptive use of military force that constitutes an act of war._ _"Donald Trump failed to seek Congressional authorization prior to striking Iran. Instead, the President's decision to abandon diplomacy and launch a massive military attack has left American troops vulnerable to Iran's retaliatory actions. We pray for the safety of the men and women of the U.S. military as they have been put into harm's way in a dangerous theater of war._ _"If Iran's nuclear program was "completely and totally obliterated" by the military strikes in June 2025, as Donald Trump boldly proclaimed, there should be no need to strike them now. Equally troublesome, the advancement of security and stability in the Middle East requires more than military might, as we painfully discovered in several failed wars in Iraq and Afghanistan. The Trump administration must explain itself to the American people and Congress immediately, provide an ironclad justification for this act of war, clearly define the national security objective and articulate a plan to avoid another costly, prolonged military quagmire in the Middle East._ _"The War Powers Resolution introduced by Rep. Ro Khanna and Rep. Thomas Massie demands that President Trump remove U.S. forces from hostilities in Iran absent Congressional authorization. House Democrats remain committed to compelling a vote on this resolution upon our return."_ **Here is the New Democrat Coalition statement:** _"The Constitution explicitly gives Congress and only Congress the authority and heavy responsibility to send our nation to war. We have not seen any intelligence indicating an imminent threat that would justify risking the lives of American servicemembers. Speaker Johnson must immediately reconvene the House so that we may vote on a war powers resolution._ _"We have no false impressions of Iran's regime. They repress their people at home, sponsor terror campaigns against the U.S. and our allies, and bolster violent insurgencies abroad. We cannot allow these realities to cloud the serious analysis and debate that must take place before we engage in war._ _"We are fully confident in the capabilities of our military and servicemembers, and are praying for their safety and success. We also know the cost of a prolonged conflict with no defined conclusion. The American people do not want another endless war. They don't want more flag-draped coffins, more of our brave young men and women needlessly sent into harm's way without a clear purpose or strategy._ _"Congress must rise to the moment and exercise its constitutional duties to serve as a check on the President before more troops are put in harm's way."_ More soon, _Rick_ |
---|---|---

clean_body: The American people do not want war. Tell Congress to stop the bloodshed and imperialism: | | | Friend, The American people do not want war. But the Trump administration’s and the Israeli regime’s illegal war of aggression on Iran has already killed hundreds of civilians, and could ignite a catastrophic regional war. For over 30 years, war criminal Netanyahu has been pushing for war with Iran, claiming—without evidence—that Iran has nuclear weapons. And when bombing Iran last June, Trump’s administration said they destroyed any Iranian nuclear program. Just a few days ago, diplomatic negotiations between the U.S. and Iran were going well. But without provocation, the U.S. and Israeli governments illegally attacked Iran. They bombed a girls’ elementary school, killing more than 150 Iranian schoolchildren. This is heartbreaking. As James Baldwin said, “The children are always ours, every single one of them, all over the globe.” Since that horrific bombing, the U.S. and Israeli governments bombed hospitals and near hospitals, killing and wounding Iranian civilians. Photos show families covered in ash while fleeing and crying out in horror. These are war crimes under international law, paid for with our taxpayer dollars. And they follow a pattern: Israel’s military has destroyed around 95% of Gaza’s hospitals and more than 90% of Gaza’s schools. The military’s own data shows that among the many thousands of Palestinians they've killed, more than 80% are civilians. None of this destruction would be possible without U.S. support, including billions of U.S. tax dollars each year. Iranians deserve freedom and self-determination. This isn’t about “freeing” the people of Iran. You cannot free people by bombing them, killing them, or imposing brutal sanctions on them that destroy their economy—which is what our government has done to Iranians. This is about taking power and resources. It’s classic U.S. imperialism, which is upheld by both U.S. political parties. | Now, Israel’s government is also using this moment to escalate deadly war crimes in Gaza and the West Bank. Our government is still sending billions to Israel’s military, after having spent nearly $1 trillion on the Pentagon’s budget (half of which will go directly to private contractors) and $175 billion on the increasingly fascist Department of Homeland Security. That’s a lot of money going toward killing people abroad and at home! All while Americans can’t afford rent, groceries, or other bills. Our government must prioritize life over death, and spend our taxpayer dollars on people’s needs rather than lining military corporations’ pockets. Nina Turner recently wrote: “Americans don’t want war. We want healthcare. We want good education for all, free of debt. We want everyone to have housing. We want livable wages. The ruling class gets rich off war while the working class dies.” Too many of my colleagues in Congress are warmongerers, from both parties. They need to hear from their constituents. To stop this war and to challenge U.S. imperialism, we’ll need a mass anti-war movement. Thank you for taking action to save lives. We will not give in to fascism’s dehumanization. I promise to keep pushing to block Members of Congress from profiting off war. And I know that together, we will keep growing the movement for our shared humanity and our human rights. In solidarity, Rashida Rashida Tlaib for Congress PO Box 32777 Detroit, MI 48232 | Paid for by Rashida Tlaib for Congress | | Sent via . Friend,

This moment requires true leadership. We need people who are willing to step up, and just as important, we need leaders who understand what working families are experiencing because they’ve lived through those same experiences.

As the daughter of immigrants, and the mother of a Brown girl who feels she has to carry a copy of her passport in her backpack because racial profiling has become normalized in this country, I know what’s at stake.

My father worked several jobs to put food on the table and keep a roof over our heads. My mother sewed buttons and zippers in a factory, and I worked at my father's five-and-dime store in Brooklyn from the time I was 12 years old. I know how hard it is today for families to make ends meet, and it feels like no one in Washington understands that struggle and is fighting to change it.

My life experience has prepared me for this moment. But while I’m taking the gloves off and doing the work, even this Cuban girl can’t fight this battle alone.

I need you with me, friend. Will you chip in today so I can take my experience, my voice, and my determination to Washington and fight for families like mine and yours? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgw_em?refcode=260302_mgw_experience_l1]

clean_body: [] Friend, This moment requires true leadership. We need people who are willing to step up, and just as important, we need leaders who understand what working families are experiencing because they’ve lived through those same experiences. As the daughter of immigrants, and the mother of a Brown girl who feels she has to carry a copy of her passport in her backpack because racial profiling has become normalized in this country, I know what’s at stake. My father worked several jobs to put food on the table and keep a roof over our heads. My mother sewed buttons and zippers in a factory, and I worked at my father's five-and-dime store in Brooklyn from the time I was 12 years old. I know how hard it is today for families to make ends meet, and it feels like no one in Washington understands that struggle and is fighting to change it. My life experience has prepared me for this moment. But while I’m taking the gloves off and doing the work, even this Cuban girl can’t fight this battle alone. I need you with me, friend. Will you chip in today so I can take my experience, my voice, and my determination to Washington and fight for families like mine and yours? Enough. This war cannot spiral even further out of control.
The American people did not vote for another endless conflict in the Middle East.
We are already seeing lives lost. We are already watching tensions escalate. And once again, decisions with enormous consequences are being made without a clear plan — _**and without the authority of Congress.**_

name: Sara Jacobs
subject: re: Iran
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
Sara Jacobs - Democrat, U.S. Congress [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89313/images/SDS/SJJ-emailheader1.png]
Friends — over the weekend, Donald Trump took illegal military action in Iran, and I want to share an important update with you about what we’re seeing, what I’m focused on, and what I believe we need to prioritize moving forward.
First, I am devastated by the news that four United States service members have been killed in action. My heart is with their families and loved ones.
We’ve also seen reports of more than a hundred civilian deaths in just the past three days, many of whom were children.
I am incredibly concerned that this is only the beginning of an ongoing, needless loss of life.
Second, let’s be clear that this operation is illegal and unauthorized by Congress.
The Constitution is unequivocal: No president can unilaterally start a war. The founders required not only congressional authorization through a vote, but a public debate on the merits of war in front of the American people.
This week, the House will vote on a war powers resolution declaring that Trump cannot continue military action in Iran without congressional approval. The point of this legislation is to make sure there is a strategy and a plan in place before starting a war that will demand the ultimate sacrifice from American service members and take more innocent lives.
I will vote yes, and I hope every single one of my colleagues joins me, no matter their political party. Our service members deserve a debate and a vote before they’re sent into harm’s way.
Third, even if this operation had been authorized, I believe this is a massive strategic mistake that will have long-reaching national security implications that do not make Americans any safer . This is a foolish war of choice, not of necessity.
Our history is clear — the United States has a terrible track record of military misadventures and regime change attempts in the Middle East (including in Iran itself). And I’m very concerned that we’ve seen no clear plan from Trump and his administration for what comes next now that Ayatollah Khamenei has been killed.
No one should mourn Ayatollah Khamenei’s death. He was a brutal dictator who terrorized his own people and the entire region. But killing him doesn’t guarantee a better outcome for the safety and security of the Iranian or the American people. Regime changes often lead to a power vacuum — that can result in civil war, an even worse regime than the one before, or a failed state, which would be catastrophic for regional stability and security.
I know many of my colleagues, and the President himself, are saying that this is about preventing Iran from having a nuclear weapon. I believe strongly that Iran must never be allowed to get a nuclear weapon — and the most sustainable way to achieve that is through diplomacy and verifiable agreements. I supported the diplomatic deal that, while imperfect, was working towards getting us there before Trump ripped it up. And we’d heard reports of progress on negotiations as recently as Friday. But instead of giving diplomacy time to work, Trump decided to bomb instead.
There are still a lot of open questions — what is the strategy? What is the end game? Will more American troops be committed on the ground? What do Trump and his administration hope will happen? From what I have heard, there are no answers to these questions.
I’m incredibly proud to represent the largest military community in the country. These are the people who are literally paying the price when we go to war. So in the coming days and weeks, I will be working every way I can to get answers to these critical questions and ensure Congress reasserts its authority in matters of war and peace.
Fourth, one of the reasons why I came to Congress in the first place was to ensure our leaders think about the long-term consequences of massive foreign policy decisions on the next generation.
Millennials like me came of age in the wake of September 11th and bore the brunt of the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan. Those ill-advised and ill-fated wars led to a deep mistrust of our institutions and leaders. Right now, Trump is saddling today’s young people not only with the physical, emotional, and monetary costs of war, but with that same mistrust . This too will have decades-long consequences, and I believe leaders of both parties must focus on restoring that trust if we want to protect the future of our country.
One last thought we should all consider: Donald Trump campaigned on peace, and right now, many of his voters rightfully feel betrayed. This is a moment for us to open the Democratic coalition and welcome in the people who do not support this President’s actions.
Thank you for reading. If you have thoughts to share, I hope you’ll reply to this email and let me know.
I will update you as often as I can throughout this rapidly developing situation.
—Sara [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=50]

body:
Red-to-Blue came from real support here at home.

| | | | |
---
Hi Peter, I wanted to take a moment to say thank you. February was an important month for this campaign, not because of any one deadline or headline, but because of the people who showed up and helped move this work forward. Supporters like you are the reason this campaign has the momentum it does. _**Last month, the DCCC named our race to its Red-to-Blue program. I want to be clear about something: that didn’t come out of nowhere, and it didn’t start in Washington.**_ [****](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/WVALwHMDaJwJ_I9Hdj0Lmw~~/AAUS1hA~/wD1X4RBIDW86BwqaimS5QmLdIU5x4l3_TkI4NCYq1MGI50k2-T_gGphFstYEmFo-AYR-7R-gIYX4PoOQVJUVyaxtLagCeqnIfOr2ACUDdxEV_L1-I_OVDiQIEug9r76Wwu5uJiXb3Iwq_GsQw4ueOLHRWT2hUPkZdNS7gEc924MTyi39u5jpAKrotHvmTnv0H1OW6UdfHSntMQpe35Q6wAcnuUZOhPmQMHfWHJuldPjeDqVhTlY4mKXpGNCaV4_a) It happened because people here in Middle Tennessee stepped up. Because you believed this race was worth fighting for. Because you invested in a campaign that’s focused on showing up, listening, and doing the work the right way. Being named a Red-to-Blue race comes with higher expectations and more eyes on what we do next. I see that not as hype, but as responsibility. And I’m grateful to be carrying it forward with supporters who care deeply about this community and its future. Thank you for being part of what we’re building. I don’t take your support for granted, and I’m proud of the campaign we’re building together. — Chaz | | |
---|---|---

Chaz Molder is the Mayor of Columbia, Tennessee, serving since 2019 and re-elected in 2022. A Columbia native and graduate of the University of Tennessee and the University of Memphis Law School, he returned home to build a career in law and public service. In a moment, I’m going to ask you to **[split a donation between Fight Like Hell Pac and my campaign for U.S. Senate to help us win this fight for our future.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126505403/605096903/324381178?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_FLHP_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20260302_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY0NjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZGU0OThhMDItN2YxNi1mMTExLWE2OWEtMDAwZDNhMWYwYTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=IhamObA6qJiB4OLl1bTsrTWLyA2rWIs5MXv6JdE7Yu4=)** But first, let me explain why your support is so important using one of my favorite Alaska winter activities — and our official state sport! [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126505404/605096904/324381178?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_FLHP_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20260302_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY0NjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZGU0OThhMDItN2YxNi1mMTExLWE2OWEtMDAwZDNhMWYwYTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=IhamObA6qJiB4OLl1bTsrTWLyA2rWIs5MXv6JdE7Yu4=) When I was growing up, salmon fishing in the summers and dog mushing in the winters, Alaska was a place of abundance. I still love to be outside. It reminds me of being a kid. But the abundance I remember doesn’t exist anymore. Now, all across Alaska, we have scarcity. Multi-national companies are trawling our waters and decimating our fish stocks. The moose, caribou, and migratory birds that used to fill our freezers are harder to find. So we buy more groceries, where the prices are just crushing Alaska families. I’m tired of politicians in DC doing nothing to stop it. All while they profit off that very same system. That’s why I’m running to fight for Alaska’s future. Systemic change is the only way to fill our homes with abundance again. But it won’t be a smooth course to the finish line. We’re racing against corporate donors and dark money groups who are going to spend big because they don’t want the rigged system to change. They’re the only ones this broken system is working for! So here’s where the lessons I learned from dog mushing come in: **As long as we’re all pulling in the same direction, we can win this.** It’s all about the team, and I know we have an amazing grassroots movement that can take this on. Thousands of people have already pitched in to help us win this seat because they want to unrig the system in DC. Now, I’m hoping that today’s the day you can join them, because it all adds up when we chip in together. So I’m asking: **[Split a donation of $20, or whatever you can, between my campaign and Gretchen’s Fight Like Hell Pac to help us build on our grassroots momentum. Alaska’s Senate race will be one of the most competitive in the nation, so please chip in to help us keep moving.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126505405/605096905/324381178?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&amount=20&refcode=AU_FLHP_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20260302_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY0NjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZGU0OThhMDItN2YxNi1mMTExLWE2OWEtMDAwZDNhMWYwYTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=IhamObA6qJiB4OLl1bTsrTWLyA2rWIs5MXv6JdE7Yu4=)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Fight Like Hell PAC and Mary Peltola will go through immediately:_ | | [CHIP IN $10 NOW](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126505406/605096906/324381178?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&express_lane=true&amount=10&refcode=AU_FLHP_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20260302_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY0NjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZGU0OThhMDItN2YxNi1mMTExLWE2OWEtMDAwZDNhMWYwYTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=IhamObA6qJiB4OLl1bTsrTWLyA2rWIs5MXv6JdE7Yu4=)

clean_body: | In a moment, I’m going to ask you to = But first, let me explain why your support is so important using one of my favorite Alaska winter activities — and our official state sport! = When I was growing up, salmon fishing in the summers and dog mushing in the winters, Alaska was a place of abundance. I still love to be outside. It reminds me of being a kid. But the abundance I remember doesn’t exist anymore. Now, all across Alaska, we have scarcity. Multi-national companies are trawling our waters and decimating our fish stocks. The moose, caribou, and migratory birds that used to fill our freezers are harder to find. So we buy more groceries, where the prices are just crushing Alaska families. I’m tired of politicians in DC doing nothing to stop it. All while they profit off that very same system. That’s why I’m running to fight for Alaska’s future. Systemic change is the only way to fill our homes with abundance again. But it won’t be a smooth course to the finish line. We’re racing against corporate donors and dark money groups who are going to spend big because they don’t want the rigged system to change. They’re the only ones this broken system is working for! So here’s where the lessons I learned from dog mushing come in: As long as we’re all pulling in the same direction, we can win this. It’s all about the team, and I know we have an amazing grassroots movement that can take this on. Thousands of people have already pitched in to help us win this seat because they want to unrig the system in DC. Now, I’m hoping that today’s the day you can join them, because it all adds up when we chip in together. body:
https://www.frostforcongress.com/ [https://www.frostforcongress.com/]
Peter,
I want to start with something that could have major consequences for our community, our state, and for the balance of power in Congress: Florida Republicans are pursuing mid-decade congressional redistricting.
Let’s be clear about what that means. When politicians redraw maps in the middle of a decade – not because communities changed, but because political power did – it’s about silencing voters and deciding who gets a seat at the table before a single ballot is cast.
Florida is one of the last pathways for Republicans to hold onto control of Congress. And instead of competing for votes, they’re going to manipulate district lines to lock in power. We won’t accept that.
Our team is closely monitoring every development. We’re preparing to push back against any attempt to disenfranchise Central Florida voters. Fair maps means fair representation – and our democracy depends on it.
At the same time, families across Central Florida are raising urgent questions about increased ICE activity in our communities. No one should have to live in fear of being separated from their loved ones. We are working with trusted local partners to ensure families know their rights, have access to accurate information, and can connect with resources if they need support. You’ll find a Know Your Rights section later in this newsletter with important information and resources.
But here is what gives me hope: community power.
We hosted a Young Professionals Mingle with more than 100 people who showed up ready to connect, organize, and build something bigger than themselves. We even offered free professional headshots because investing in the next generation means giving them real tools to succeed. That energy reminded me exactly what’s at stake.
Whether we are fighting back against rigged maps, standing with immigrant families, or building spaces for young leaders to grow, our mission remains the same: we are here to protect working families and strengthen our democracy.
Make sure to read through the rest of this newsletter for updates on our redistricting fight and ways you can get involved in the weeks ahead.
With love & gratitude,

🛑 KNOW YOUR RIGHTS!
Everyone—regardless of immigration status—has rights under the U.S. Constitution. If ICE comes to your door, here’s what you need to know:
Do Not Open the Door
You are not required to open the door unless ICE shows a warrant signed by a judge with your correct name and address. Ask them to slide it under the door or show it through a window.
You Have the Right to Remain Silent
Do not answer any questions. Anything you say can be used against you. Calmly say:
“I choose to remain silent and want to speak with an attorney.”
Do Not Sign Anything
Don’t sign any documents ICE gives you without reviewing them with an immigration attorney. You have the right to ask for a translation if you don’t understand something.

clean_body: [] Peter, I want to start with something that could have major consequences for our community, our state, and for the balance of power in Congress: Florida Republicans are pursuing mid-decade congressional redistricting. Let’s be clear about what that means. When politicians redraw maps in the middle of a decade – not because communities changed, but because political power did – it’s about silencing voters and deciding who gets a seat at the table before a single ballot is cast. Florida is one of the last pathways for Republicans to hold onto control of Congress. And instead of competing for votes, they’re going to manipulate district lines to lock in power. We won’t accept that. Our team is closely monitoring every development. We’re preparing to push back against any attempt to disenfranchise Central Florida voters. Fair maps means fair representation – and our democracy depends on it. At the same time, families across Central Florida are raising urgent questions about increased ICE activity in our communities. No one should have to live in fear of being separated from their loved ones. We are working with trusted local partners to ensure families know their rights, have access to accurate information, and can connect with resources if they need support. You’ll find a Know Your Rights section later in this newsletter with important information and resources. But here is what gives me hope: community power. We hosted a Young Professionals Mingle with more than 100 people who showed up ready to connect, organize, and build something bigger than themselves. We even offered free professional headshots because investing in the next generation means giving them real tools to succeed. That energy reminded me exactly what’s at stake. Whether we are fighting back against rigged maps, standing with immigrant families, or building spaces for young leaders to grow, our mission remains the same: we are here to protect working families and strengthen our democracy. Make sure to read through the rest of this newsletter for updates on our redistricting fight and ways you can get involved in the weeks ahead. Friend, Over the weekend, Donald Trump opened a new and deadly front in the Middle East -- one that’s shaping up to be the most dangerous escalation since the Iraq War. **Trump campaigned on a promise to end our endless wars. He lied.** By striking Iran, he’s putting American service members in harm’s way with no plan, no clear objective, and no exit strategy. I know what it means to serve. I enlisted in the Army Reserve when I was 18, and I’ve seen the consequences of war up close. The human cost, the instability, the toll on communities both here and abroad are heavy -- especially when working families at home are already struggling to make ends meet amidst the affordability crisis. clean_body: | = Friend, Over the weekend, Donald Trump opened a new and deadly front in the Middle East -- one that’s shaping up to be the most dangerous escalation since the Iraq War. Trump campaigned on a promise to end our endless wars. He lied. By striking Iran, he’s putting American service members in harm’s way with no plan, no clear objective, and no exit strategy. I know what it means to serve. I enlisted in the Army Reserve when I was 18, and I’ve seen the consequences of war up close. Senator Warner would like to share these words with you directly: President Trump ran on lowering inflation. Instead, he’s raised health care costs, used tariffs to raise your taxes, and now, is pursuing a costly war-of-choice with no end in sight. I was down in Hampton Roads over the weekend, where many of the American sailors who are in the conflict area are from. I had four events yesterday, half the crowd in every one of these events knew people who were deployed. And they have no idea why their sons and daughters are being put in harm's way. THREE points means we are not just competing, we are a real threat and inches away from making history. And we only have ONE day until primary Election Day on March 3. = | = This isn't just a fantasy anymore. body:
#
On Instagram last weekend, someone asked me, “Did the **S** afeguard **A** merican **V** oter **E** ligibility (SAVE America) Act get passed?”
No. It has passed the House. It has not yet passed the Senate.
If it went to the Senate as a standalone bill, it would require 60 votes to pass.
I do not see 10 Democrats signing on to passing it — but I’m also not sure if even the entire Republican caucus in the Senate would pass it.
It seems as though House Republicans are trying to engage in a pressure campaign on the Senate. They may try to append it to some other legislation. I don’t know how successful that would be.
The SAVE Act is very dangerous. It hurts everybody, but **it especially penalizes married women because your ID needs to match your birth certificate in order to vote**.
It is a poll tax on everybody. So you would need to pay for a passport — or another copy of your birth certificate — in order to vote.
This administration is much more prepared and planned this time around, in terms of the kinds of chaos that they're trying to unleash.
They want us to say, "America has gone to hell in a handbasket" and give up. **Hell no**.

| | Peter,
---
| | Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud.

He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus.

He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness.

And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible.

I saw it up close -- _Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. _

But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything.

_**He started observing the Sabbath. **_

Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance.

_But as an act of obedience. _

As a way of saying, **_" God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." _**

Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped.

He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield.

No email. No media. No work.

He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children.

It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much.

But over time, it changed him.

And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned...

clean_body: The numbers aren’t breaking their way anymore| | | | | Peter, | | Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud. He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus. He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness. And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible. I saw it up close -- Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything. He started observing the Sabbath. Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance. But as an act of obedience. As a way of saying, " God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped. He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield. No email. No media. No work. He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children. It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much. But over time, it changed him. And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned... This was Charlie's final message. His final act of trust. A book not about politics... but about peace. It 's called: Stop, in the Name of God. Peter, like I mentioned, this isn't a political book. It's not a culture war manifesto. It's a call to stop. To rest. To breathe. To return to God. Because Charlie believed America hadn 't just forgotten truth... It had forgotten trust. Trust that the world keeps spinning when you step away. Trust that God is in control. Trust that rest is not weakness -- it's worship. In Stop, in the Name of God, you'll discover: 🔥 How Charlie reclaimed the Sabbath in a world built on burnout 🔥 What sacred rest gave back to him -- as a father, husband, and believer 🔥 Why he believed this message could spark revival in a restless generation Charlie wrote this book because he knew what it meant to nearly lose his peace -- and what it felt like to find it again. That's the heartbeat of his final message. Charlie Kirk didn't waste his time on earth. He left behind a family. He left behind a movement. And he left behind this truth... For anyone ready to step off the treadmill... and walk back toward what's eternal. Peter, thank you -- in advance -- for helping reach the next generation with truth, faith, and moral courage. These are the very things Charlie gave his life for. May the message he left behind lead you -- just as it led him -- to a deeper trust in God... A stronger love for your family... And a renewed peace in your own soul. For Charlie, Justin Streiff Chief Operating Officer Turning Point USA P.S.Stop, in the Name of God is Charlie Kirk's final message -- written in obedience, shaped by Scripture, and grounded in trust in the Lord. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

Hi friends, Over the weekend, the Trump Administration, along with Israel, launched a major assault on Iran — without debate, without congressional approval, and without any accountability. Trump ran on false promises to end forever wars, but he addressed the American people from the comfort of Mar-a-Lago this weekend and callously declared _“there will likely be more”_ U.S. troop deaths because _“that’s the way it is.”_ Well, history has shown us exactly where these war drums lead: It means risking the lives of our service members. It means putting innocent civilians in Iran, people who have no say in this violence, directly in harm’s way. It means fueling anti-American sentiment and dragging the United States into yet another forever war. And it means putting our planet at risk. Because let’s be honest about what shadows conflicts like this: Iran sits on some of the largest oil reserves in the world. We have seen, time and again, how wars wrapped in the language of “freedom” and “security” are entangled with resource interests. When oil is involved, the line between liberation and exploitation becomes dangerously thin. Generations of Iranians have waited for this moment. For the regime to fall, for the light of democracy, and the sight of relief to peak through after decades of repression, executions, and stolen futures. But we have already seen this administration’s disregard for human life at home. And when military strikes hit civilian neighborhoods — including an elementary school for girls — it is painfully clear: this president does not value human life abroad either. **The American people overwhelmingly oppose a war with Iran. Never in our history has the United States Supreme Court (SCOTUS) played a more vital role in protecting America's Bill of Rights. With Joe Biden in the White House, America's Constitution is merely another impediment to hurdle over. His record setting executive orders have sought to bypass the legislative process and usurp our founding documents, and the due processes therein.
In all the years of the Presidency, never has one man issued so many executive orders, proclamations, declarations, and decrees during their first two years on the job. As a matter of fact, Joe Biden has issued more than the last four presidents combined. In what's becoming a monarchy process from the White House, we have seen job killing executive orders, congressional bypassing proclamations and declarations, and he now has his sights on dismembering the Second Amendment.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.IpET_IijSPSn-5lBfdRSfOGCKZh4dpYoQ0Kxhntdj7s?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=189708839)
In a recent speech he called on congress "to enact common sense gun law reforms", despite state constitutional protections. He followed those comments up by saying "This administration will not wait for the next mass shooting to heed the call to act." Joe Biden and the progressives intend on deploying the same unconstitutional sidestepping tactics as they have on the existing 85 executive orders, 64 presidential memoranda and 210 proclamations already issued since he took office.
The second amendment to the constitution was clear and concise when crafted, "the right of the people to keep and bear arms, shall not be infringed." Our founders came from tyranny and understood the need for its citizenry to protect themselves from all enemies foreign and domestic. The framers intentionally eliminated ambiguity in the language, as the recent Supreme Court ruling has shown. Over the last century, Supreme Court rulings on the matter have been consistent in validating the second amendments language. In June of 2008, the Supreme Court issued its first decision since 1939 reaffirming the rights of a citizen to bear arms. District of Columbia v. Heller was a death blow to the anti-gun lobby because it clarified and codified every component of a citizen's right to legal gun ownership. The progressives have been plotting to undermine this ruling for the last 13 years.
Democrat led cities like Chicago, New York, Baltimore and even the District of Columbia, to name a few, have the most restrictive gun laws in the nation, yet they lead the nation in gun violence. It seems the bad guys do not have a problem finding guns. As a matter of fact, these cities lead in most every violent crime category that is tracked by the justice department. For the first time in over half a century, we have seen year over year, record setting increases, as the innocent victims continue to pile up on their watch.
We are fortunate for now that a majority on the Supreme Court are constitutionalists. The court should never be in the business of legislating from the bench. Their role is clear, they are the final arbiter in the judiciary process, and the legal branch of constitutional oversight. Their role is to interpret the constitution, not to pick and choose which parts it agrees with. Despite death threats, picketing and parading of their homes and deliberate intimidation under threat, I applaud the six justices that understood their oath before God and the American people. Proving once again that the mob is no match for, we the people. Thank you and God bless America, Vincent

# **Trump won 't rule out ground troops in Iran, says operation "way ahead of schedule" after killing 49 leaders**
President Donald Trump **[told The NY Post Monday he's not ruling out sending US ground troops into Iran](https://substack.com/redirect/af91fcf4-8ef4-4956-b25c-d07a489be1a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** "if they were necessary," saying he doesn't have "the yips" about boots on the ground like other presidents, adding Operation Epic Fury killed 49 Iranian leaders in one day--a goal originally estimated to take four weeks--and is progressing "way ahead of schedule."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/af91fcf4-8ef4-4956-b25c-d07a489be1a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Why it matters:** While Secretary of War Pete Hegseth confirmed at a Pentagon press conference that no American troops are currently inside Iran, he also didn't rule out the possibility, saying Trump "ensures our enemies understand we'll go as far as we need to go to advance American interests" but "you don't have to roll 200,000 people in there and stay for 20 years." At least four US service members have died after an Iranian counterstrike on a US operations center in Kuwait.
* **The polling divide:** A Reuters/Ipsos poll found only 27% of Americans approved of the strikes while 43% disapproved, and a CNN/SSRS poll showed 41% approved while 59% disapproved--but Trump dismissed the numbers, saying "I don't care about polling. I have to do the right thing" and claiming "if you did a real poll, the silent poll," support would be higher. Trump said he made the final decision after talks collapsed in Geneva Thursday, partly because intelligence showed Iran was "surreptitiously resuming work on nuclear projects at a totally different site," adding "they wanted to make a nuclear weapon, so we destroyed them completely."

* * *
# **Iranian-Americans celebrate Khamenei 's death in NYC, cities worldwide as families in Iran dance amid strikes**
About 500 Iranian-Americans **[marched through Midtown Manhattan on Sunday](https://substack.com/redirect/a23ffc3b-df05-43ca-a3d2-25e73348eb18?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** chanting "USA! USA! USA!" and "TRUMP, TRUMP! THANK YOU, THANK YOU!" while waving the banned Iranian Lion and Sun flag and carrying "Make Iran Great Again" banners to celebrate the death of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, killed Saturday alongside over 40 top officials in a US-Israeli strike.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/94171e64-b532-495c-801b-fa9bccd28a30?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Why it matters:** Demonstrators sang the old Iranian national anthem banned since the 1979 Islamic Revolution, with 45-year-old Ramin Sohrab saying "at home they don't call this 'war.' They are calling this 'human rescue.'" Reza Ebrahimi, 37, told The Post his mother in Iran said "she would rather sacrifice her life that the world be safe," adding his brother was shot during recent protests and that Iranian-Americans are "the voice of our families who are over there and cannot speak."
* **What 's happening in Iran:** Nehzat Lavvaf, 47, said her mother reported many Iranians are sheltering in place as bombs fall and ignoring Iranian state TV urging people to go outside "to kill the innocent people" and increase civilian casualties for anti-US propaganda. Lavvaf's family said they're celebrating the strikes even while sheltering, with her mother "so happy" they're having celebrations and changing "all the music to dance music," saying "we have been all waiting for this moment." Similar celebrations erupted in Los Angeles, London, Paris and Canada, with London demonstrators waving Israeli flags alongside Iranian flags "in a rare show of comity between two people who have been divided by rivalry and war."

# Kuwaiti locals rescue downed U.S. pilots after friendly fire blunder
Three U.S. F-15E Strike Eagles supporting strikes against Iran were[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/18090e1b-19e8-4132-99f0-c11ea0e0d2a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[mistakenly shot down by Kuwaiti air defenses over Kuwait](https://substack.com/redirect/18090e1b-19e8-4132-99f0-c11ea0e0d2a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** late Sunday, but all six crew members ejected safely and were recovered in stable condition, with locals rushing to aid a female aircrew member in heartwarming video footage released Monday.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/1b5a5c2e-da83-40e1-b6a9-9d6164742a50?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Friendly Fire Chaos** : Three fighter jets downed in apparent mishap amid Iranian attacks involving aircraft, missiles, and drones during Operation Epic Fury.
* **Crew Survival Confirmed** : All six aircrew--three pilots and three weapon systems officers--ejected successfully and remain in stable condition after quick recovery.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/277b76bc-c5a6-4bf2-bf26-3e50e351e695?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Kuwaiti Gratitude Shown** : Video captures locals checking on and reassuring a female servicemember, with one saying "Thank you for helping us" despite the incident.
* **Investigation Underway** : CENTCOM notes Kuwait acknowledged the error and expresses thanks for their ongoing support as cause probe continues.

* * *
# "Special Relationship" in tatters? UK PM refuses to allow U.S. full access to airfields even after Iranian drone attack!
Prime Minister **[Keir Starmer declared Monday that US forces will not use British military bases](https://substack.com/redirect/0971be58-b6e1-43a7-8f05-138393eb9805?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in Cyprus for operations in the ongoing war with Iran, citing their unsuitability, despite approving limited defensive access to other UK bases following Iranian attacks and US pressure.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0971be58-b6e1-43a7-8f05-138393eb9805?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Cyprus Exclusion Clarified:** Starmer emphasized the Akrotiri base in Cyprus remains off-limits to US operations due to practical unsuitability, even as tensions rise.
* **Defensive Only Stance:** UK limits support to destroying Iranian missiles at source or launchers, rejecting participation in broader US-Israeli offensive strikes.
* **Drone Strike Aftermath:** An Iranian drone hit RAF Akrotiri's runway shortly before the announcement, causing minimal damage but prompting evacuations and flight cancellations nearby.
* **Trump Criticism Noted:** President Trump expressed disappointment over Starmer's initial hesitation, calling the eventual approval useful but delayed.

## Hughes Family Takes Double Gold
The [Hughes family](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2O5CAUBODT4IzW64cbjwOCTZzNphtaGB4_O2AsYLrF7Ve9V5ispJI-lerP5_6pY4qn_60zKefd3l3ZT3q1RL1T3ZP-ohxNiF6flZr5pqybKT3vCCg5CA64Wx3T2OfJKkeEJCZS92XBecXHB05BEdztx8OsjwNWkAcY9zju2ohVzjAvh56iemsgAFGAALjdF73KVUpc7DJLY9gMZGMv9fa3xLMHcmmUJ9WbKXlKKvR-NSZ-MdwYbue4SuvviuH2hhlugO8sGG7tKrU3hlso5osG9_pJvAfi4dsHatzpHNPg9KQ6eoin55aMttT4Qa5U4iWNfEXDfSp1MNymquz1iinFJhc2g886pv_D-o8ffSr8FwAA__8AkIwn) made Olympic history in Milan, bringing home two hockey gold medals in one week at the 2026 Winter Games. Mom Ellen Weinberg-Hughes helped the U.S. women’s team [beat Canada 2-1 in overtime](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DvOpDAQBODTQGbkaR6GwMEmZLPphsiy27h3_UC4ZxC3X81c4Y9LqtJXf57b01CkvP82CbXf_ca-bBmvGpEZzy2af5jIBtpNPrHaFyZTbeG0gYRJyF5I2JyheG9D67RHBOxb1A-lYFhgnKENenn4YZi9VxKm2aF0ErySfpxdr8YRx5b0p032EqCXvZTdQ5llWqYJlFPDZG0zSHTE5ez-Fsoc0Me7vPHsbElt1IH5qE3_q4G1gfW6ri6H-MkaWD-YBtbw2gNW4U2ieItQDqyCiwgYD_HKxOhEZcNYxUVZQHZiL9GJhM5EYVh8uSXe6SBb21O746IYqU6qGeSeDH33Wv7xiW8N_wMAAP__4pmIkA) as a player development consultant. Days later, sons Quinn and Jack Hughes delivered another 2-1 overtime win over Canada, securing the first U.S. men’s hockey gold since 1980. Raised largely in Mississauga, Ontario, after their father Jim took a player development role in the Toronto Maple Leafs’ organization, Quinn and Jack came up through Canada’s hockey system before [powering Team USA in Milan](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO4yAURb8Gd47gQWBdUGzjLttuiQg8GxIwHsCJ_PejzC9Md6UrnSOd_zdzszHFbf1nM-plXUxfitnw3RL2jtUk-8QcXYir3So2d2C2zZWeDVCQI-UjBeNtTKcRg9cLIiAfUDOlQExw_QND0IKB4sxZvHJ69XcANblFUumZYMwKMUT9oVFOATjllF6YspOcpATllZDOEUHRx17q5VHi1gMu6SwvrBdX8pB06H1vhP8lMBOYA9rX-XkIzG0vtTcCc0ln3qP7zHCsAdt4r6UHrG18WPccv464bWM6nkhgHqr2-zumFJtURNA125h-XP3XkV4avgMAAP__SbB9DA). Quinn led the team with eight points and scored the overtime winner against Sweden in the quarterfinals. Jack scored four goals and netted the golden goal in the final, losing teeth in the process. Youngest brother Luke, also a first-round NHL pick, watched from New Jersey while on long-term injured reserve. All three brothers are the only American siblings ever selected in the first round of the NHL draft.
## Man Who Can’t Swim Saves Baby
A Chicago man who [can't swim jumped into frigid Lake Michigan](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDuO4zAMhk8jdwwUWrbXhYpt3M22Wxq0TMuc0SOQlAS5_SKDucF2BD7if_39WD9IgiT_hyLbwx9rO_Ka-FkDt8ZlDfTFUdwpnlLh6u4cqbrc4ooaR9A9aFx3kvBaTbfbgxm579hepwnNjMMv7E5rcLjiuF-pH2jSg96RD2fmrZ-Z0Q2mE_tW071G7HWv9eU60TzO44jTPpnROWU079JyuXxmSe3kI7zyg8vF5dgFe7Z2q6r_rXBRuGwhuy8X7ps7xZHPl1y8wuVtoXDR-H0rXH4wRErweY-3CpJahndlaBkqPRg22l5AR-MCtZUcAhfYQn7-_D7pTQT8nWsFieCzJA-SFC5dsfvtKSFIHSdltI8k4Ttw---lHxb_BQAA__9ngZR3) after a powerful gust of wind blew a stroller carrying an 8-month-old girl into the water at Belmont Harbor. Lio Cundiff, 30, was on the phone with his aunt when he heard the mother scream. | | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

body:
Folks,

**I’m sick of the two sets of rules in this country – one for the rich and well-connected, and one for everyone else.**

And I’m angry when I see politicians like my opponent, Jon Husted, protect their billionaire donors at all costs.

body:

Tell Your Senator:
Oppose Steve Pearce for Bureau of Land Management Director

The U.S. Senate Committee that oversees our public lands is voting this Wednesdayto confirm Steve Pearce for Bureau of Land Management (BLM) Director — we need
to take action before they do. Pearce is the wrong choice for the job: he has a track record of supporting the
sell off of public lands and close financial ties to the oil and gas industry — a clear conflict of interest. The BLM stewards over 245 million acres of
public lands, and if Pearce is confirmed, we could lose hundreds of millions of acres to fossil fuel drilling and corporate greed.

This is yet another attempt by the Trump administration to sell off our public lands to serve the interests of Big Oil and Gas. Tell your senator: Oppose Steve Pearce! https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/- ADD YOUR NAME >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/k_ Peter, Our public lands are under threat, and we need you to take action right now. The
U.S. Senate Committee that oversees our public lands is voting to confirm Steve
Pearce — a longtime friend and investor in Big Oil and Gas — to be the next
Bureau of Land Management (BLM) Director. The BLM stewards over 245 million
acres of public lands, and needs a director who will serve our public lands and
the American people — not Trump’s dirty oil and gas cronies. Tell your senator: oppose Steve Pearce! https://links.messages.lcv. “Sell off Steve” Pearce is the wrong choice for the job — for our public lands,
our communities, and our planet. Not only has he supported the sell off of
public lands, but he also has close financial ties to the oil and gas industry,
and a history of trying to shrink and block the designation of national
monuments. As a former member of Congress, Steve Pearce voted to fast-track public land
sales, including BLM lands, and backed what was called “one of the largest land
giveaways in our nation’s history.” He even wanted to sell off our public lands
to pay down the deficit, arguing “most of it we do not even need." We do need our public lands.Not only are these lands national treasures, they also help sustain local
economies and the collective well-being of people and our planet. If our public
lands are sold off and opened to oil and gas drilling, communities across the
country will experience more pollution and dirtier air, more asthma attacks and
missed school days for kids, and higher rates of diseases like cancer. And heat,
droughts, and destructive fires and storms fueled by climate change will worsen. This is yet another attempt by the Trump administration to sell off our public
lands to serve the interests of Big Oil and Gas, while everyday Americans pay
the price — higher utility bills and worsening health and safety conditions.
With Pearce at the helm, there is no doubt this administration will continue to
prioritize fossil fuels over the affordable, safe, clean energy people and our
planet need. Protect our public lands from Pearce — add your name today >> https://links.messages.lcv. Thank you for helping protect our public lands today, so that they survive long
into the future. America Fitzpatrick

body:
Chris Pappas just voted NO on the SAVE Act, again.

Let that sink in, Patriot.

This bill would do one simple thing: require proof of U.S. citizenship to
vote in federal elections.

That’s it. Common sense. Yet Chris Pappas voted to keep the loopholes open.

He voted to protect the system that lets non-citizens get driver’s licenses
in states like New York and California, and then show up on voter rolls.

<https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/save-act-email-acs/?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20260227_save-act-email_sb?&utm_medium=SUMMIT&utm_source=rcl&utm_campaign=20260302_save-act_indirect>
FIGHT BACK – DONATE TODAY
<https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/save-act-email-acs/?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20260227_save-act-email_sb?&utm_medium=SUMMIT&utm_source=rcl&utm_campaign=20260302_save-act_indirect>
And when we call it out? They lie. They distract. They try to scare women and
families into thinking this bill is something it’s not.

Don’t buy it.

The SAVE Act doesn’t take away anyone’s vote; it protects it. What it does do
is close the backdoors that bad actors want to leave wide open.

We show ID to fly. We show ID to buy a six-pack. Why on earth wouldn’t we
show proof of citizenship to pick a president?

Here’s the truth: the Left is fighting the SAVE Act because they want these
loopholes. They know their policies are failing. And they know the only way
they stay in power is by blurring the lines of who gets to vote.

We can’t let that happen.

I'm standing with the American people. Are you?
<https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/save-act-email-acs/?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20260227_save-act-email_sb?&utm_medium=SUMMIT&utm_source=rcl&utm_campaign=20260302_save-act_indirect>

Let’s make it loud and clear: only Americans should vote in American
elections. Period.
FIGHT BACK – DONATE TODAY
<https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/save-act-email-acs/?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20260227_save-act-email_sb?&utm_medium=SUMMIT&utm_source=rcl&utm_campaign=20260302_save-act_indirect>
Let’s fight back. Let’s pass the SAVE Act. And let’s fire the politicians who
won’t.

For America,

Friend, As we celebrate **Women's History Month** , we honor the courageous women who stood up and raised their voices to fight for the right to vote. We know that Tennessee played a deciding role in this struggle, becoming the 36th and final state needed to ratify the 19th amendment. It all came down to one state representative, Harry Thomas Burn, who changed his tiebreaking vote to the affirmative after a letter from a _persuasive constituent_ , his mother, _Phoebe Ensminger Burn_. Now, just a little over 100 years later, **Tennessee Senator Marsha Blackburn** is working hard to pass the **SAVE Act** , a bill that threatens to restrict the ability to vote for millions of Americans, in particular, disenfranchising married women. It’s more important now than ever that we honor Tennessee’s suffragette history, and send an unequivocal message to lawmakers that we should be working to **protect women’s right to vote** , and to **vote ‘NO” on the SAVE act.** **Take Action:** Contact Senator Blackburn today to voice your opposition to the SAVE Act and remind her of Tennessee’s historic legacy in standing up for women’s rights. Your voice makes a difference. | | [TAKE ACTION](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126511636/605115599/1482519211?refcode=3.1.26_eom_thank_you&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODg3MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MmZjNzViYi05MzE2LWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2ExZjBhOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GaKR4LJ6gKp3fcWsLLU_E5vMQl8-_TAFpa991YzriPg=&emci=65a2f1d5-8916-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&emdi=62fc75bb-9316-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&ceid=53531271)
